summary: Restoring communication for people who have lost the ability to speak or move after a brain injury is a major challenge. While intracranial implants now enable high-performing brain-computer-interfaces, non-invasive alternatives are still lagging behind. Here, we present Brain2Qwerty v2, a model that can decode the production of natural sentences solely from real-time magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings. By collecting 22,000 sentences typed by nine subjects, each recorded for 10 hours, our model leverages character, word and sentence-level representations to achieve an average word error rate (WER) of 39%. For our best participant, the model accurately decodes half of the sentences with one word error or less. Critically, decoding accuracy log-linearly improves with data volume, suggesting that the performance gap with intracranial approaches could be partially bridged through data scaling. We show that AI enables this performance in three main ways: the substitution of hand-crafted pipelines for event detection with deep learning, the finetuning of large language models to extract semantic representations, and the deployment of AI agents to iteratively refine our decoding pipeline via automated code development. Together, these results show that non-invasive brain-to-text decoding starts to operate at a level of accuracy previously thought exclusive to surgical implants, opening a path toward safe and efficient brain-computer-interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Brain2Qwerty v2模型,利用深度学习从非侵入性脑磁图(MEG)信号中解码自然句子,实现了39%的平均词错误率(WER),最佳受试者WER为22%,显著缩小了与非侵入式脑机接口与侵入式脑机接口之间的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 侵入式脑机接口(iBCI)虽已能高精度恢复失语或瘫痪患者的沟通能力,但其外科手术风险、神经炎症反应及临床推广的物流障碍限制了其大规模应用。现有非侵入式替代方案(EEG、fMRI)受限于信噪比低或时间分辨率差,而此前基于MEG的脑-文本解码方法(如Brain2Qwerty v1)存在三大局限:需要按键时间戳、句子重建效果差、数据规模过小(每人仅1小时)。
AI.method: 1. 数据采集:9名健康志愿者,每人10小时MEG记录(306通道),共22,000条英语句子,采用延迟打字任务范式。2. 三模块联合架构:(a) Encoder(基于BrainModule+Conformer)以CTC损失训练,从连续MEG信号中预测字符序列;(b) Aligner采用SigLIP对比损失,通过CTC tokenizer(基于空格键切分)将MEG嵌入对齐到LLM词向量空间;(c) LLM(Qwen3-4B)经LoRA逐被试微调后进行Model Soup融合,同时接收CTC文本和MEG神经词嵌入作为输入,自回归生成目标句子。3. Auto Research:三个Cursor(Claude Opus 4.6)AI编码智能体在约束超参数空间内自主迭代优化管道配置,与Optuna贝叶斯优化对比。4. 训练策略:三阶段端到端训练(CTC→CTC+对比→CTC+对比+LLM交叉熵),采用模态丢弃(modality dropout)增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 1. 异步编码器CER从SpanishBCBL的59%降至EnglishBCBL的25%,与同步方法相当。2. 性能随数据量呈对数线性增长(Pearson r=-0.99),在90小时聚合数据下未见饱和。3. 句子多样性独立改善解码性能(非重复句子CER 45% vs 重复65%,p<0.001)。4. Brain2Qwerty v2平均WER=39%±4%,显著优于Encoder(N-gram)的43%±4%(p<0.005);SemER=5.9%±0.5%,显著优于基线。5. 最佳受试者22% WER,28%句子完美解码,47%句子最多仅1个词错误。6. CTC tokenizer显著优于句子级对齐和patch分词(WER 39% vs 46%/49%)。7. Model Soup(逐被试训练LoRA再权重平均)随LLM规模从0.6B→4B持续提升,而联合训练趋于平台期。8. 三个Auto Research智能体平均相对WER改进约17%,显著优于Optuna的8.6%(p<10⁻⁶),并泛化到全部9名受试者;但在开放式目标下智能体失败。9. 传感器消融显示150通道OPM级系统仅损失约5.7个百分点WER。10. 移除MEG神经词嵌入使WER恶化16%,证明LLM确实在读取神经信号而非仅校正CTC文本。
AI.conclusion: Brain2Qwerty v2首次联合训练字符、单词和句子三级表征,从非侵入性MEG连续信号中解码有意义的自然句子,达到此前被认为只有侵入式植入物才能实现的精度水平,为无需神经外科手术的安全脑机接口开辟了道路。对数线性的数据扩展规律暗示可通过增大数据规模进一步弥合与侵入式BCI的差距(后者打字WER<2%,手写CER<6%);传感器消融表明可穿戴OPM-MEG系统有望支持临床部署。同时,自主AI编码智能体被证明能在约束搜索空间内显著优于传统贝叶斯优化,但仍无法替代人类研究者完成开放式架构探索。当前局限包括:被试间变异大、依赖健康志愿者按键、模型非因果导致实时延迟高,以及与侵入式方法之间仍有显著性能差距。

title: Temporal Multi-Signal Fusion for Token-Level Hallucination Detection
comment: 17 pages, 14 figures, 23 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Token-level hallucination detectors score each token independently from a single signal, and fail exactly when the generating model is confidently wrong. This paper instead treats hallucination as a temporally extended span and detects it by sequence labeling: each token is scored from a 33-dimensional feature stream that fuses text statistics, Natural Language Inference (NLI) entailment, and language model surprisal, with no access to model internals. A Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) over these features reaches an AUC of 0.840 on RAGTruth (10 seeds), an 11-point gain over an independent logistic-regression baseline (p = 0.002, Wilcoxon signed-rank). A controlled decomposition attributes most of the gain to temporal order rather than model capacity: evidence propagates from confident positions to ambiguous neighbors within a span. The same 0.845 ceiling recurs across recurrent, state-space (Mamba), and attention architectures, locating the bottleneck in the feature set rather than the model. Because it reads only the generated text and external signals, the detector works on closed-source models, and it keeps working on text produced by language models it never saw during training, losing under 4% AUC.

AI.tldr: 本文将token级幻觉检测重构为序列标注任务，提出基于33维多信号融合特征（文本统计+NLI蕴含+LM困惑度）结合BiGRU时序建模的黑盒检测器，在RAGTruth上达到0.840 AUC，比独立LogReg基线提升11点，且在未见过的源模型上AUC损失不足4%。
AI.motivation: 现有token级幻觉检测器对每个token独立打分，恰好在生成模型"自信地犯错"时失效。核心原因是幻觉不是点事件：RAGTruth中幻觉span的中位长度为5个token，状态持续概率P(H_t|H_{t-1})=0.902远高于起始概率P(H_t|F_{t-1})=0.006（150:1），76%的标签熵可由前一步标签预测。但现有方法（内部探针、不确定性估计、NLI分类）都假设token间独立，丢弃了这一关键时序规律。
AI.method: 1）从外部信号构建33维per-token特征：文本统计（20维，含n-gram重叠、新颖度动态、滑动窗口统计量）、NLI蕴含分数（7维，来自DeBERTa-v3-large）、LM困惑度（6维，来自TinyLlama-1.1B），无需访问生成模型内部；2）用BiGRU（h=64，2层，121K参数）进行双向序列标注，类别加权BCE训练；3）控制分解实验区分非线性容量（MLP）、序列聚合（Shuffled BiGRU）和时序顺序（BiGRU）的贡献；4）在RAGTruth和PsiloQA上进行跨模型留一法和跨数据集零样本迁移测试。
AI.result: BiGRU+全部信号在RAGTruth上达0.840±0.007 AUC（F1=0.257），显著优于LogReg（0.730±0.001，p=0.002）。控制分解表明：时序顺序贡献44%（+4.9 AUC），序列聚合贡献24%（+2.6），非线性容量贡献32%（+3.5）。跨六个源模型留一法迁移仅退化3.8%（0.808 AUC），PsiloQA→RAGTruth反向迁移（0.744）优于正向（0.634），表明标注密度比数据集规模更重要。Mamba/BiLSTM/BixLSTM/Transformer+注意力等架构在plateau调度下均收敛至0.843-0.845 AUC，性能瓶颈在特征而非模型。结合Lookback Lens可达0.866 AUC。CRF模型softmax打分严重失校（前向-后向边际可恢复+17.9 AUC）。附录X证明内部探针远不如黑盒特征（0.543-0.637 vs 0.770-0.833）。
AI.conclusion: 1）token级幻觉检测应被重新框定为序列标注问题，时序结构是最大未开发信号；2）多信号融合是必要但非充分条件（无时序建模时仅达0.730）；3）标注密度比数据集规模对迁移更关键；4）黑盒方法因不需访问模型内部而适用于闭源API，与白盒注意力信号正交可叠加。未来工作可探索流式检测，在幻觉span完成前触发干预。局限：span级F1（0.394）低于专用编码器LettuceDetect（0.589），英语数据集，5.6%的正例率限制了token级F1。

title: Global Index on Responsible AI 2026 : Conceptual Framework and Methodology
summary: This report presents the methodology of the Global Index on Responsible AI (GIRAI), 2nd Edition. This edition refines the 1st Edition by strengthening the distinction between framework existence and implementation, restructuring dimensions from three to five thematic areas, introducing more granular variables for framework quality, and applying a multi-stage review and validation process. An independent statistical pre-audit was conducted to assess the coherence and robustness of the framework. GIRAI assesses responsible AI governance across five dimensions: Inclusion and Diversity, Ethics and Sustainability, Labour and Skills, Trust and Safety, and Use of AI in Public Service. Each dimension has a number of indicators (38 in total), organised into three pillars, namely AI Policy (17 indicators on government frameworks and implementation, assessed through primary data), CSO Engagement (5 indicators, primary data), and Enabling Conditions (15 indicators on the structural factors shaping responsible AI governance, assessed through secondary data), and a government Use of Unacceptable Risk AI (URAI) indicator (primary data), applied separately as an accountability penalty to the final score. Data was collected by 135 country-level researchers through a structured global survey, complemented by secondary datasets. The count, scope, enforceability, thematic coverage, and implementation levels of the data points are coded into numerical variables, normalised to a scale of 100, aggregated through pillar weights of 60% (AI policy), 10% (CSO Engagement), and 30% (Enabling conditions). A deduction penalty is applied for countries with evidence of URAI. This documentation enables systematic cross-national comparison, supporting policymakers, civil society, and AI developers to identify where commitments are translating into enforceable protections and where critical gaps remain.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了《全球负责任人工智能指数》（GIRAI）第二版的评估方法学。该方法通过五大维度、38个指标和三支柱加权框架（AI政策60%、公民社会参与10%、支撑条件30%），由135名国别研究人员通过全球调查收集数据，对各国负责任AI治理水平进行系统性跨国比较，并设置"不可接受风险AI"（URAI）扣分机制。
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能治理在全球范围内受到日益关注，亟需一套系统、严谨、可比较的跨国评估工具，以衡量各国负责任AI承诺与实际执行之间的差距。该研究旨在弥补现有评估框架在"框架存在性"与"实施情况"之间的混淆，提升指数的方法论严谨性，并为政策制定者、公民社会和AI开发者提供决策依据。
AI.method:
1. 将第一版的三维度重构为五大主题领域：包容性与多样性、伦理与可持续性、劳动力与技能、信任与安全、公共服务中的AI应用。
2. 设计38个指标，分为三个支柱：AI政策（17个指标，初级数据）、公民社会参与（5个指标，初级数据）、支撑条件（15个指标，次级数据），另设一项独立的"不可接受风险AI"（URAI）问责扣分指标。
3. 通过135名国别研究人员进行结构化全球调查，并辅以次级数据集。
4. 对数据点的数量、范围、可执行性、主题覆盖度和实施水平进行数值编码，归一化至100分量表。
5. 采用支柱加权聚合（60%/10%/30%），并对URAI证据进行扣分惩罚。
6. 实施多阶段评审与验证流程，并开展独立统计预审计以评估框架的连贯性与稳健性。
AI.result: 形成了一套经过方法学优化和统计预审计验证的GIRAI第二版评估框架。该框架能够支持跨国系统性比较，识别各国在负责任AI治理方面的可执行保护措施与关键差距。第二版相比第一版在框架存在与实施的区分度、维度结构、指标颗粒度以及审查验证流程方面均有所强化。
AI.conclusion: GIRAI第二版提供了一个更为严谨、透明和可比较的全球负责任AI治理评估工具，能够帮助政策制定者、公民社会和AI开发者明确哪些国家已将AI承诺转化为可执行的保护机制，并揭示仍需弥补的关键治理缺口。该方法学为负责任AI治理的跨国问责与持续监测奠定了方法论基础。

title: Language Models for Portuguese: A Systematic Mapping Study
summary: In recent years, the rapid development of language models has transformed the field of Natural Language Processing through a wide range of applications. However, the development of language models has not progressed uniformly across all languages. In the case of the Portuguese language, there has recently been a growing effort by academia and companies to develop language models and create data resources for Portuguese. These efforts have resulted in the rise of an increasingly diverse ecosystem of language models for Portuguese. However, information on these models remains dispersed in scientific publications, technical reports, model repositories, and project documentation. This survey presents a systematic mapping study of language models developed for Portuguese, providing a comprehensive overview of the current state of the field. We map a total of 46 models, characterizing them by various aspects, including base model, architecture, computational resources, training datasets, licensing, code availability, data, and model weights. Furthermore, we analyzed the evolution and relationships among these models through a phylogenetic perspective, identified current research gaps and opportunities, and discussed future directions for the development of language models for Portuguese.

AI.tldr: 该文对葡萄牙语语言模型开展了系统性梳理与映射研究，共收录46个模型，并从模型基础、技术架构、算力、训练数据、许可、代码、数据及模型权重可用性等维度进行比较；同时借助系统发育视角分析模型演进与关系，进一步指出研究空白和未来方向。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型快速发展，葡萄牙语模型及相关数据资源日益增多，但相关资料分散于论文、技术报告、模型仓库和项目文档中，缺少统一、全面的领域图谱，因此需要对葡萄牙语语言模型生态进行系统整理。
AI.method: 采用系统映射研究方法，检索和整理针对葡萄牙语开发的语言模型，并依据基础模型、架构、计算资源、训练数据集、许可证、代码、数据和模型权重等特征进行分类与比较；进一步使用系统发育（phylogenetic）视角分析模型之间的演进关系。
AI.result: 共识别并映射46个葡萄牙语语言模型，呈现了该领域当前的技术、资源、数据和开放性特征，揭示了模型之间的发展与继承关系，并总结了现有研究中的空白及潜在发展机会。
AI.conclusion: 葡萄牙语已形成多样化且持续发展的语言模型生态，但相关工作仍存在进一步发展空间。未来应加强模型与数据的开放共享、完善资源建设、拓展葡萄牙语变体与任务覆盖，并推动更系统、可复现和可持续的语言模型研发。

title: The Deontic Gap: Large Language Models and the Modal Language of Obligation
summary: Modal auxiliaries such as must, should, and have to mark necessity and obligation within the contexts of speaker authority and interpersonal stance. We examine whether large language models (LLMs) reproduce contemporary human patterns of deontic modal usage. Across three primary corpora, an external benchmark, two controlled replications, and a naturalistic eleven-model replication, AI-generated text consistently underuses positive deontic modals (must, should, have to, had to) relative to contemporary humans. Historical comparison with the Google Books Ngram corpus (1920-2022), used as a heuristic calibration against the published-prose record, shows that AI modal frequencies fall within the range of formal published English, whereas contemporary human modal rates in informal digital contexts often exceed twentieth-century book baselines. Phrase-level decomposition shows that the AI-human modal gap is concentrated in constructions central to interpersonal stance (should, have to, had to), while AI matches or exceeds humans on need to in instructional and question-answering contexts but not in persuasive student writing, indicating that the modal profile is genre-conditional. The findings suggest that LLM modal usage reflects the formal written resources on which these models were trained, while underusing the modal constructions through which contemporary human writers mark immediate, interpersonal obligation.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察了大语言模型（LLMs）在生成文本时对道义情态动词（如must、should、have to）的使用模式，发现AI生成的文本持续低估了正向道义情态动词的使用频率，其情态使用模式更接近20世纪正式出版英语，而非当代人类在非正式数字语境中的高频率使用，且这种差异主要集中在人际立场相关的构式中。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型已广泛应用于写作辅助，但其生成文本是否真正反映当代人类在数字交流中的语言模式尚不清楚。道义情态动词（如must、should、have to）承载着说话者权威和人际立场功能，是研究AI与人类语言差异的重要窗口。研究者旨在探究LLM是否能够再现当代人类对道义情态动词的使用模式。
AI.method: 研究采用多层次、多语料的比较分析框架：（1）三个主要语料库与一个外部基准的对比；（2）两项受控复制实验；（3）十一款模型的自然主义复制实验；（4）与Google Books Ngram语料库（1920-2022）进行历史比较，作为已出版散文记录的启发式校准；（5）短语级分解分析，区分不同道义情态构式在不同体裁（指令性、问答、说服性学生写作）中的使用差异。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：（1）AI生成的文本在正向道义情态动词（must、should、have to、had to）的使用上持续低于当代人类；（2）AI的情态频率落在正式出版英语的历史范围内，而当代人类在非正式数字语境中的情态使用率常超过20世纪书籍基线；（3）AI与人类的情态差距主要集中在should、have to、had to等人际立场核心构式上；（4）AI在指令性和问答语境中匹配或超过人类对"need to"的使用，但在说服性学生写作中未达此水平，表明情态分布具有体裁依赖性。
AI.conclusion: LLM的情态使用反映了其训练所依赖的正式书面语料资源，而低估了当代人类作者用于标记即时性、人际义务的情态构式。这一发现揭示了AI语言生成在语体适应性方面的局限：模型倾向于复制正式出版英语的保守模式，而未能捕捉当代非正式数字写作中更为丰富的人际情态表达。

title: Entropy-Constrained Adaptive Stochastic Quantization
summary: Adaptive stochastic quantization (ASQ) is a recently introduced quantization approach that optimizes the Mean Squared Error (MSE) for a given input while preserving unbiasedness. It is designed to alleviate the communication and memory bottlenecks of modern data and machine learning workloads, including model, gradient, and KV-cache compression and nearest-neighbor search. Further, practical systems can then compress quantized data with a lossless entropy encoder. However, existing unbiased methods, including ASQ, choose their quantization values without considering this later encoding stage, leaving accuracy on the table. We formulate the Entropy Constrained Adaptive Stochastic Quantization (ECASQ) problem, which jointly selects adaptive quantization values to minimize MSE under an entropy budget and an unbiasedness constraint. We give an optimal dynamic program with $O(sd^2)$ time and $O(d^2)$ space for a length-d vector and at most s quantization values, and a GPU-friendly approximate dynamic program with $O(sd^2)$ time and $O(d)$ space. The approximation guarantees that the solution has an MSE no larger than the optimal solution that uses one fewer bit of entropy per entry. We also provide an iterative refinement procedure for the approximation solution that, in our experiments, yields near-optimal results while retaining a substantial speed advantage over our solver for the optimal solution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ECASQ（熵约束自适应随机量化），首次将自适应随机量化（ASQ）的MSE优化与后续熵编码阶段的比特预算联合考虑，同时保证无偏性。给出了最优动态规划算法（O(sd²)时间，O(d²)空间）和GPU友好的近似算法（O(sd²)时间，O(d)空间），后者具有1比特近似保证，并辅以迭代精化过程。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习工作负载（模型压缩、梯度压缩、KV缓存压缩等）需要量化方法具备三个关键特性：(1)无偏性、(2)对输入的自适应性、(3)对熵编码输出大小的优化。然而现有方法（包括ASQ、QUIVER、QSGD等）都无法同时满足这三个条件：ASQ虽自适应且无偏但未考虑熵编码；熵感知方法不保证无偏性；QSGD/QUIVER等非自适应的方法依赖预设网格，精度较差。这构成一个尚未解决的理论空白。
AI.method: 1) **问题建模**：将ECASQ形式化为带熵预算b、码本大小约束s和无偏约束的MSE最小化问题，并允许从任意允许字母表P中选择量化值。2) **拉格朗日松弛**：引入乘子λ将硬约束转化为λ-ECASQ松弛问题（MSE + λ·H(X̂)）。3) **最优DP**：设计新动态规划dp_OPT(i,ℓ,j)跟踪最后两个量化值以正确计算熵贡献，结合SMAWK加速（利用列反序后的Monge性质）和Hirschberg空间缩减。4) **近似DP**：通过优化联合熵代理H(I,B)代替真熵H(X̂)，利用区间可分结构，仅需跟踪前一个量化值即可，在O(d)空间内求解，并证明其MSE不超过最优b-1比特解的MSE。5) **三色迭代精化**：将量化值按索引模3分为三组并行优化，对组内值用二分搜索微调位置，在GPU上高效执行。6) **时间共享分析**：通过证明任意非相邻随机舍入的两路时间共享可被仅使用相邻舍入的方案支配，回答了Lagrangian方法何时最优的问题。
AI.result: 在BF16合成向量（d=16384）和100个真实模型张量（Qwen2.5、Gemma-3、Llama-3.2、Phi-3.5）上的全面评估表明：(1)最优ECASQ在所有匹配比特率下均优于QUIVER、QSGD和均匀量化基线；(2)五轮精化将近似解的相对vNMSE超额从4.97%降至1.37%（最大4.06%），无精化版本均值仍优于所有非ECASQ基线；(3)运行时优势显著：在d=262144下，最优、近似和精化版本的平均耗时分别为6.39秒、0.26秒和0.33秒，对应24×和19×加速比；(4)经验1比特保证在所有检验案例中均成立；(5)时间共享对确定性最优解的理论增益上界的中位数仅约1-2%，表明Lagrangian解通常已接近最优。
AI.conclusion: ECASQ首次统一了无偏性、输入自适应性和熵感知优化三大性质，填补了量化文献中的关键空白。最优DP算法配合SMAWK与Hirschberg提供了严格的最优性保证，近似算法配合GPU友好的并行精化则提供了实用性，两者在精度–效率曲线上各得其所。时间共享理论分析进一步表明实践中单Lagrangian解即接近最优。该框架适用于广泛的现代ML压缩场景，并已证明在真实模型权重、激活和KV缓存张量上一致优于现有量化基线。

title: When Do LLMs Actually Help? Evaluating LLMs as Data Quality Annotators
summary: LLMs have been increasingly used to catch data quality issues automatically, but we know very little about how consistent these judgments actually are. This study tests an LLM on two e-commerce data quality tasks, entity matching and brand mislabeling, against rule based baselines and human verified ground truth, under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting. On entity matching while using the Abt Buy benchmark (2,194 labeled pairs), a simple rule based baseline (F1=0.950) performed about as well as LLM zero shot prompting (F1=0.948). Moreover, a few-shot prompt revision that looked effective on a small validation sample reduced full-scale performance to F1=0.914. This showed that small sample prompt evaluation can be misleading. On brand mislabeling detection, using 500 Amazon product listings with synthetically injected labeling errors, the LLM clearly outperformed a naive rule based baseline (F1=0.833 vs 0.721), because it could draw on background knowledge of brand product relationships that a simple rule could not access. Testing consistency across repeated runs (200 pairs, 5 runs at temperature 0.7) showed the model agreeing with itself 99.7% of the time on average, with 99% of pairs giving identical answers across all 5 runs. Using majority voting across these runs only improved F1 by 0.005, at 5 times the inference cost. These results suggest that the value of using an LLM over traditional methods depends heavily on the task. LLMs offer little advantage when strong lexical signals already exist, but a clear advantage when the task requires background knowledge, all while remaining highly consistent across repeated queries.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了GPT-4o-mini作为数据质量标注器在两个电商任务（实体匹配和品牌错标检测）上的表现与可靠性，对比了基于规则的方法和LLM方法，并测试了LLM在重复运行中的一致性。核心结论是：LLM相对于传统方法的价值高度依赖于任务性质——在强词汇信号已足够时优势有限（实体匹配F1=0.948 vs 规则0.950），而在需要背景知识时则显著占优（品牌错标F1=0.833 vs 规则0.721）；同时LLM在重复运行中具有极高的一致性（99.7%）。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地被用于自动化数据质量标注，但其判断的一致性和可靠性研究不足。现有评估多关注单次预测性能，而忽略了标注者在重复执行中是否稳定，这对实际数据质量工作流中的自动化决策至关重要。同时，LLM相对于传统规则方法的优势边界尚不清晰——何时LLM真正有用、何时传统方法已足够，是实践中亟需解答的问题。
AI.method: 研究在两个电商数据质量任务上评估GPT-4o-mini：(1) 实体匹配——使用Abt-Buy基准（2,194对平衡标注），对比Jaccard词重叠基线（阈值0.2）与LLM零样本/少样本提示（含SKU指导）；(2) 品牌错标检测——使用Amazon产品数据集（500条，人工合成标注），对比朴素子串匹配规则与LLM零样本提示。一致性测试在200对子样本上进行5次重复运行（温度0.7），计算自洽率和多数投票效果。所有实验采用GPT-4o-mini，温度0（主结果）以保证可复现性。
AI.result: 实体匹配：Jaccard基线F1=0.950，LLM零样本F1=0.948，LLM少样本+SKU指导F1=0.914（性能下降）。小样本验证看似有效的提示改进在全规模上失效，说明小样本评估具有误导性。品牌错标：规则基线F1=0.721（精度0.564，召回率1.000），LLM零样本F1=0.833（精度0.827，召回率0.840），LLM凭借品牌关系背景知识显著胜出。一致性测试：5次重复运行下平均自洽率99.7%，99%样本答案完全一致；多数投票仅提升F1 0.005，却增加5倍推理成本。错误分析表明LLM在低词汇重叠但语义等价的样本中取胜，在共享精确型号/SKU但描述文本不同的样本中失利于规则方法。
AI.conclusion: LLM相对于传统规则方法的价值高度任务依赖：当任务存在强词汇信号时LLM优势有限（如实体匹配），而当任务需要文本外的背景知识时LLM显著占优（如品牌错标）。LLM在重复推理中表现出极高一致性，但对二元简单任务的一致性结论不应外推到更开放或主观的任务。提示工程的关键教训是必须在全规模数据上验证而非仅依赖小样本，否则易出现过泛化。实践者应按任务逐个评估LLM的数据质量标注价值，并在引入提示改进时进行全规模验证。未来工作应扩展到更多模型家族、在品牌错标任务上测试一致性，并探索更贴近生产环境的微妙错误场景。

title: Are LLMs Safe Beyond Text: Do Emojis Expose Gaps in Safety Evaluation
comment: 3 pages. Accepted at ACL 2026 Workshop on Evaluation in Practice: Methodological Rigor, Sociotechnical Perspectives, & Community Collaboration (EvalEval)
summary: Safety evaluations of large language models (LLMs) predominantly rely on text-based adversarial prompts, potentially overlooking vulnerabilities arising from alternative input representations. This work examines emoji-augmented prompts as a test case for this gap, evaluating 50 prompts across four open-source LLMs (Mistral 7B, Qwen 2 7B, Gemma 2 9B, Llama 3 8B). Results show substantial variation in robustness: Gemma 2 9B and Mistral 7B exhibit non-zero success rates (10%), Llama 3 8B 6%, while Qwen 2 7B shows complete resistance (0% success rate). A chi-square test ($\chi^2 = 32.94, p < 0.001$) confirms significant differences in outcome distributions. These findings indicate that robustness is sensitive to input representation, and that evaluations restricted to standard text prompts may underrepresent model vulnerabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了表情符号增强提示词（emoji-augmented prompts）对大语言模型安全对齐的绕过效果，发现仅依靠文本提示的安全评估可能低估模型的脆弱性。四个开源 LLM 在 50 个表情符号提示下的成功率存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型的安全评估主要依赖基于文本的对抗性提示，可能忽视由替代输入表征（如表情符号）引发的漏洞。表情符号在分词和语义理解中带来独特挑战，可能绕过关键词安全过滤器，但其在 LLM 提示级安全对齐中的影响尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 在四个开源 LLM（Mistral 7B、Qwen 2 7B、Gemma 2 9B、Llama 3 8B）上测试相同的 50 个表情符号增强提示，采用两种策略：emoji stuffing（表情符号与文本交错）和 emoji chaining（表情符号序列隐式编码有害意图）。响应分为三类结果（Successful、Partial、Failed），使用基于关键词的启发式分类结合人工验证，通过卡方检验比较模型间结果分布差异。
AI.result: Gemma 2 9B 和 Mistral 7B 的攻击成功率均为 10%，Llama 3 8B 为 6%，而 Qwen 2 7B 完全抵抗（成功率为 0%）。Gemma 2 9B 合规率最低（66%），Mistral 7B 合规率较高（88%）；Qwen 2 7B 虽无成功输出，但部分响应比例较高。卡方检验结果（χ²=32.94, p<0.001）表明模型间的结果分布差异具有统计学显著性。
AI.conclusion: 表情符号增强提示暴露了表层安全机制与语义理解之间的不匹配，表明模型的对抗鲁棒性对输入表征敏感。表情符号序列引入的模糊性导致响应在拒绝与遵从之间不一致。仅依赖标准文本提示的评估方法可能低估由替代输入表征引发的脆弱性，因此安全评估应纳入非标准输入形式以更全面地刻画模型失效模式。

title: What Can Artificial Intelligence Learn from Medicine? Generative Analogies and Reliable Machine Learning Systems
comment: Accepted for publication in Studies in the History and Philosophy of Science (cite published version)
summary: In the past few years, machine learning (ML) has been widely (and to an extent, successfully) implemented in medicine. However, uncertainties surrounding ML have made it difficult to establish the bases of its epistemic and methodological warrants. In the literature, a parallel has been drawn between medicine and ML, suggesting that we should model epistemic and methodological standards for ML on the standards of clinical translation. By developing tools from Hesse work, we characterise the nature of this parallel as a generative analogy between the process of clinical translation and the process of building ML systems. We identify more precisely the epistemic and methodological warrants of clinical translation that are typically only mentioned when appealing to the analogy, and we show in which sense such warrants apply analogically to the context of ML. In particular, we interpret warrants of clinical translation in reliabilist terms, and we show how this can inform a new form of ML reliabilism, which is distinct from (though compatible with) existing reliabilist accounts in philosophy of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文运用Hesse的类比理论框架,论证机器学习(ML)在医学中的应用可通过"临床转化过程"与"构建ML系统过程"之间的生成性类比来理解其认识论和方法论依据,并提出一种新的ML可靠主义形式。
AI.motivation: 尽管机器学习在医学领域已有广泛应用并取得一定成功,但其认识论和方法论基础仍不明确。文献中常将医学类比作为ML认识论标准的基础,但该类比的性质尚未被严格阐明。因此,需要系统地分析这一类比,以建立ML的认识论和方法论正当性。
AI.method: 借助Hesse关于类比的理论工具,作者:(1)将"临床转化"与"ML系统构建"刻画为一种生成性类比;(2)识别临床转化中通常仅在诉诸类比时被提及的认识论和方法论依据;(3)在可靠主义(reliabilism)框架下重新阐释这些依据;(4)将该框架类比性地延伸至ML情境。
AI.result: 论文表明:(1)临床转化过程与ML系统构建过程之间存在结构性的生成性类比关系;(2)临床转化中的认识论和方法论依据可在可靠主义术语下被重新阐释;(3)由此可形成一种新的ML可靠主义(ML reliabilism),它与现有AI哲学中的可靠主义流派既有区别又相兼容。
AI.conclusion: 通过Hesse类比理论,本文为ML的认识论基础提供了新的可靠主义解释路径,既区别于又兼容于现有AI可靠主义理论,从而为ML的临床应用提供更坚实的哲学基础。

title: A systematic review of machine learning techniques to address diagnosis and treatment of autism: challenges and opportunities
summary: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a developmental disability characterized by challenges in social interaction and communication. As the causes of ASD remain unclear, identifying relevant features and hidden correlations is crucial for early diagnosis. This systematic review evaluates 55 studies from 2017 to 2023 on the application of machine learning (ML) techniques to ASD. The primary objective is to examine recent ML applications in ASD research, identifying trends, techniques, and datasets that enhance diagnosis and treatment. Supervised learning methods dominate, as they align well with ASD diagnostic needs; however, the role of deep learning is expanding with greater data availability. Emerging techniques based on hybrid methods, where unsupervised, deep learning, and fuzzy logic could be included, will be interesting to observe in the future. The review highlights key challenges and opportunities, particularly the need for models that can integrate complex data -such as genetic and clinical information- to improve diagnostic accuracy and treatment outcomes. Additionally, incorporating innovative data sources, like wearable devices and biometric sensors, could enable continuous and non-intrusive monitoring, providing a more holistic understanding of ASD. Findings emphasize that addressing current challenges requires interdisciplinary collaboration and expanded datasets tailored to ASD. Future ML models will benefit from broader multimodal data integration, enabling researchers to more comprehensively address the complexities of ASD.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于机器学习技术在自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）研究中应用的系统综述文章，通过评估2017至2023年间55项研究，综述了ML在ASD诊断和治疗中的最新进展、趋势及技术。
AI.motivation: 由于ASD的确切病因尚不明确，识别相关特征和隐藏关联对于早期诊断至关重要。研究者旨在系统评估近年ML技术在ASD研究中的应用现状，明确技术趋势、数据集使用情况及未来发展方向。
AI.method: 采用系统性综述方法，筛选并分析了2017至2023年间发表的55项相关研究，重点考察有监督学习、无监督学习、深度学习及混合方法在ASD诊断与治疗中的应用，并讨论数据集特征与多模态数据整合情况。
AI.result: 结果显示有监督学习方法占据主导地位（因其与ASD诊断需求高度契合），但深度学习的应用正在数据量增长背景下逐步扩展。当前仍面临数据整合（特别是基因与临床信息融合）及非侵入式持续监测等挑战。
AI.conclusion: 未来ML模型的发展将受益于更广泛的多模态数据整合、可穿戴设备与生物传感器的应用，以及跨学科合作，从而更全面地理解ASD的复杂性并提升诊断准确性与治疗效果。

title: Bidirectional representational alignment between biological and artificial neural networks
summary: Recent work has shown that representational alignment between biological and artificial neural networks is asymmetric: model representations predict neural responses much better than neural responses predict model representations. This asymmetry raises the question of whether representational geometry contributes to bidirectional representational alignment. We hypothesized that steering representational geometry during training can systematically influence bidirectional alignment. To test this hypothesis, we developed a computational framework that integrates spectral regularization with bidirectional predictivity analyses. As an initial demonstration, we evaluated our framework using self-supervised contrastive vision models. Steering the spectral geometry of the learned representations substantially increased reverse predictivity with modest reductions in forward predictivity, yielding a 55% relative improvement in bidirectional predictivity. These improvements were accompanied by reduced effective dimensionality and a reorganization of the shared representational subspace, within which forward and reverse predictivity became approximately symmetric at intermediate spectral exponents. Overall, these findings demonstrate that representational geometry can be systematically steered to modulate bidirectional representational alignment between biological and artificial neural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合谱正则化（spectral regularization）与双向预测性分析的框架，通过控制自监督对比视觉模型（SimCLR+ResNet-50）训练过程中的谱几何（spectral decay exponent），系统性地调控其与猕猴下颞叶皮层（IT cortex）神经表征之间的双向表征对齐（bidirectional representational alignment）。研究发现，增大谱指数可大幅提升反向预测性（reverse predictivity），同时仅轻微降低正向预测性（forward predictivity），从而使双向预测性（BPI）获得55%的相对改善，并在共享表征子空间中实现接近对称的正反向预测性。
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现生物与人工神经网络之间的表征对齐是单向不对称的：模型表征预测神经响应的能力远强于神经响应预测模型表征的能力。这种不对称性引发了"表征几何（representational geometry）是否导致该不对称"的疑问。本文旨在验证一个核心假设：在训练过程中主动引导（steer）表征的几何结构（如谱指数），能否系统性地影响双向表征对齐。
AI.method:
1. 数据：ImageNet-1k子集（每类100张图像）用于训练；猕猴IT皮层神经响应基准（168个记录位点，3200个视觉刺激）用于评估。
2. 模型：SimCLR自监督对比学习框架，采用ResNet-50编码器+两层投影头（128维嵌入）。选择encoder.layer4.0.bn1层提取激活值。
3. 谱正则化：在标准InfoNCE对比损失基础上，添加谱正则化项 L_spectrum = λ|α − α̂|，其中α为测得的谱衰减指数（通过对激活矩阵进行低秩SVD并在log-log谱上拟合幂律得到），α̂为目标谱指数，λ为正则化强度。
4. 双向预测性评估：采用岭回归（5折交叉验证）+信度校正的Pearson相关系数量化正向（模型→神经）和反向（神经→模型）解释方差，并计算双向预测性BPI = 2·Rfwd·Rrev/(Rfwd+Rrev)。
5. 分析：按测得谱指数分箱；分析"公共单元"（反向预测性排名前20%）与"独特单元"（后20%）；计算有效维度（参与比）。
6. 超参数：训练200个epoch，SGD+momentum，余弦退火lr，τ=0.2，谱正则化在前10个epoch后启用。
AI.result:
1. 谱正则化有效引导了表征几何：测得谱指数随目标值单调增加，正则化强度越大，测得值与目标值越吻合。
2. 反向预测性随谱指数显著提升：λ=3时，最高端α箱中的反向解释方差从基线的12%增至29%（图2）；λ=2时趋势一致（图3）。
3. 正向预测性轻微下降：正则化导致正向解释方差普遍降低，且其变化与正则化强度关系更密切（图7、图8）。
4. 双向预测性（BPI）显著改善：从约20%增至31%，相对改善55%（图6）。
5. 共享表征子空间重组织：在"公共单元"（top 20%）中，中间谱指数下正向与反向预测性接近对称（37% vs 45%，图9）；"独特单元"改善较小（图10）。
6. 有效维度降低：有效维度随谱指数增大而下降（图11），表明表征方差被集中到更少的有效维度上。
AI.conclusion: 本文证实了表征几何（特别是谱指数）可作为调控生物-人工神经网络双向表征对齐的可操纵属性。通过谱正则化引导训练，可显著提升反向预测性并降低正反向不对称性，使双向预测性获得55%的相对改善。这些改善伴随着有效维度降低和共享表征子空间的重组织。谱指数应被视为与对齐变化相关的多种表征属性之一而非唯一因果因素。局限性包括：仅在一层、一个模型（SimCLR/ResNet-50）、一种学习目标和单一神经基准上进行了验证。未来工作应探索更多表征几何属性、自适应正则化策略，以及将该框架推广至其他架构、模型对之间的对齐研究。

title: What Makes Software Issue Resolution Tasks Difficult for Agents?
summary: Background. Advances in agentic systems are simultaneously, and rapidly, saturating benchmarks. Despite this often discussed phenomena, benchmark scores remain difficult to interpret due to the lack of control and characterization of task difficulty. More specifically, we currently have little understanding of what makes one task harder than another, and to what extent task difficulty is predictable from static task properties. Aims. We propose a measurement framework to investigate and systematically quantify what structural properties of software tasks correspond to agent success rates for issue resolution tasks. Method. We conducted a large scale empirical study on CoderForge-Preview, the largest open dataset of coding agent trajectories to date, by extracting features across task patch, repository and prompt. We evaluated the predictive power of each feature against task outcomes using ensemble methods, SHAP attribution, and effect size analysis. Results We found that task difficulty is substantially predictable from static features (AU C = 0.863) and is largely driven by patch fragmentation and repository scale. Prompt linguistic features become visible among top contributors for tasks in the mid-band, revealing a layered structure of difficulty. Conclusion. The difficulty of an issue resolution task is encoded in its structure. This enables static, pre-hoc difficulty estimation and lays the groundwork for difficulty-controlled benchmark construction for evaluation of agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于静态特征的度量框架，通过分析代码补丁、代码仓库和提示词的结构属性，预测AI编码代理在软件问题解决任务中的成功率（AUC=0.863），揭示任务难度主要由补丁碎片化和仓库规模驱动。
AI.motivation: 当前AI编码代理在SWE-bench等基准上的总分已超过50%，但基准得分难以解读，缺乏对任务难度的控制与表征。现有研究未能系统性地揭示是什么结构属性使一个任务比另一个更难，以及任务难度在多大程度上可从静态属性中预测。IRT等方法的非确定性特征也影响了可复现性。
AI.method: 在CoderForge-Preview数据集（45,769个任务，来自SWE-Smith和SWE-Rebench）上提取三类共54个确定性特征：补丁特征（18个→13个）、仓库特征（14个）和提示词特征（31个→27个）。使用VIF过滤后，训练Logistic回归、随机森林和XGBoost模型，预测三个结果变量（pass_rate、any_success、maj_success）。通过SHAP归因分析、消融实验和分难度区间分析评估特征贡献。
AI.result: 1. 静态特征具有强预测能力（XGBoost AUC=0.863，MCC=0.549，R²=0.408），优于线性模型；2. 补丁复杂度与仓库结构共同贡献几乎全部可预测方差（27特征AUC=0.861），提示词语言特征单独使用时接近随机（仅AUC=0.599）；3. 关键特征为patch_lines_deleted、patch_num_hunks和patch_hunk_gap_mean（均呈负向影响）；4. 提示词特征在中间难度区间（mid-band）作用增强——70.3%的中等难度任务中，至少一个提示词特征进入SHAP前五贡献者，揭示"分层难度结构"。
AI.conclusion: 任务难度编码于静态结构中。这支持以下应用：(1)基于结构平衡性的基准审计；(2)按难度分层评估代理能力；(3)面向开发者的依赖校准。特征完全确定性，无需LLM推理，可复现性强。未来工作将跨多个代理构建每代理难度画像。该框架可推广至功能实现、测试生成等代理SE任务。

title: FairGlucose: A CGM Fairness Benchmark Reveals Subgroup Disparities Hidden in Population-Level Validation
summary: As CGM-based AI tools approach clinical deployment, whether their accuracy is equitable across patient demographics remains insufficiently tested. To enable this evaluation, we constructed FairGlucose, a 300-patient CGM cohort balanced across 12 demographic strata (age x gender x type 1/type 2 diabetes), with 132,480 forecasting samples and 3,945 unique behavioral events (meals, exercise, medication) logged by 81 patients. Benchmarking 33 models across four families on 2-hour glucose forecasting, we find that population-level external validation can conceal substantial subgroup disparities. Aggregate out-of-distribution metrics appear stable (approximately 1.0), yet subgroup-level ratios range from 0.8 to 1.4, with T1D patients showing 6 mg/dL higher prediction error than T2D (p < 0.001). This disparity persists across all 33 models, suggesting a property of the prediction task rather than any single architecture. Further analysis shows that subgroup performance gaps align with the proportion of clinically hard cases, and that input-length sensitivity varies across demographics, motivating personalized configurations. Frontier LLMs underperform specialized neural models by 1-6 mg/dL; behavioral events contribute negligibly (approximately 0.1 mg/dL) even under oracle event access. These findings establish that population-level validation alone is insufficient for equity assessment of digital health AI, motivating subgroup-disaggregated reporting as a default standard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FairGlucose基准，构建了一个300名患者在12个人口统计学分层（年龄×性别×1型/2型糖尿病）上平衡的CGM队列，包含132,480个预测样本和3,945个行为事件标注。通过对33个模型（涵盖统计方法、机器学习、神经时序网络和前沿大语言模型四大类）进行2小时血糖预测基准测试，揭示了总体层面的外部验证指标（OD/ID≈1.0）掩盖了严重的亚组间性能差异（亚组比率范围0.8–1.4），T1D患者比T2D患者预测误差高6 mg/dL（p<0.001），该差距存在于所有33个模型中，表明这是任务层面的固有属性而非架构缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前CGM（连续血糖监测）AI工具正逐步走向临床部署，但其预测准确性在患者人口统计学亚组间是否公平尚缺乏充分测试。现有CGM基准（如GlucoBench、OhioT1DM、GluFormer）存在人口统计学不平衡、样本量小、缺乏行为事件标注和公平性评估等问题。总体层面的性能指标可能掩盖系统性亚组层面的失败，导致某些患者群体被系统性服务不足，因此亟需一个公平性感知的基准测试框架。
AI.method: 1）构建FairGlucose数据集：300名患者均匀分布于12个人口统计学分层（年龄：18-39/40-64/≥65 × 性别：男/女 × 糖尿病类型：T1D/T2D），每组25人，从美国移动健康平台采样，包含132,480个标准化预测样本（24小时输入+8小时输出）和81名患者记录的3,945个时间戳行为事件（膳食、运动、药物）；2）数据划分：每组20名held-in患者（训练15天/验证2天/测试ID 3天）和5名held-out患者（测试OD 12天）；3）评估33个模型（统计3个+ML 4个+神经时序20个+LLM/基础模型6个）在30分钟、1小时和2小时预测范围内的性能；4）采用rMSE和Clarke Error Grid Zone A作为评估指标；5）提出五维公平性评估框架：亚组公平性、输入长度敏感性、实例级难度、事件感知评估、准确性-公平性权衡；6）采用患者级bootstrap置信区间和置换检验进行统计推断。
AI.result: 1）最佳模型为NS-Transformer（rMSE=25.6 mg/dL，Clarke A=76.4%），LightGBM在临床准确性上最佳（Clarke A=76.8%）；2）T1D患者预测误差比T2D患者高6.3 mg/dL（95% CI [4.3, 8.2]，p<0.001），该差距在所有33个模型中持续存在；3）总体OD/ID比率≈1.0，但亚组层面比率范围为0.8-1.4（如T2D 65+男性OD/ID=0.90，T2D 40-64女性OD/ID=1.42）；4）输入长度敏感性因亚组而异：年长T2D患者需要更长CGM历史，年轻T1D患者对短输入窗口容忍度高；5）亚组性能差距与临床困难病例比例对齐，顶级模型在简单病例上获益更大但在困难病例上改善有限；6）行为事件对预测贡献极小（约0.1 mg/dL），即使在oracle事件访问下也如此；7）前沿LLM（GPT-5.1、Claude 4.5、Gemini 3）比专业神经模型差1-6 mg/dL。
AI.conclusion: 总体层面的外部验证指标（≈1.0）系统性地掩盖了CGM预测准确性中0.8-1.4范围的亚组层面变异，这种差距跨越四种范式的全部33个评估模型持续存在，表明差异反映预测任务本身的属性而非架构层面的人工产物。亚组性能差距与临床困难病例比例对齐，输入长度敏感性因人口统计学而异，呼吁个性化配置。研究建议亚组分解报告应成为数字健康AI评估的默认标准，类似于临床试验按人口统计学亚组报告结果的方式。FairGlucose将公开队列元数据、评估分割、代码和33个模型的参考排行榜，为可重复的公平性研究提供基础设施。

title: One Gate Is Not Enough: Composing Stateful Pre-Action Controls for Agentic AI
comment: 29 pages. Code and data: this https URL (Zenodo DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22003399 )
summary: Agentic AI systems take consequential actions governed by more than one pre-action control at once: authority, resource, and evidence gates that can admit, degrade, or remediate an action before it executes. This paper's central object is remediation-induced control coupling: a remediation applied by one control can change the action, evidence, or context another control evaluates, invalidating that control's earlier judgment. We formalize this coupling and give a remediate-and-regate protocol that restores per-action soundness in the current bounded, idempotent setting under its stated assumptions. We further show that the two implemented remediation operators (evidence substitution and resource-budget downroute) do not commute -- a finite-model checker finds concrete counterexample instances -- making remediation order part of the control-plane semantics rather than an implementation detail. A governed evidence buffer that trusts its own most recent admitted write is a further instance of the same problem at the level of state -- current admissibility does not imply future reference trustworthiness -- and is vulnerable to poisoning from declared-uncovered defect classes; two mitigations reduce, not eliminate, that exposure. Supporting results establish the exact condition under which positive-weight linear aggregation of gate outcomes can compensate a member veto, a unified cross-control Evidence Set, and that composition manufactures no new detection coverage, reported honestly. Empirically, on a deterministic open-data artifact composing three published engines unmodified, CH1-CH5 meet their registered decision rules across all 30 pre-registered seeds; CH6 does so under W1 but not under the smaller W2 workflow, reported as such. This is a mechanism demonstration on open payload data with a synthetic metadata layer, not a claim about production prevalence.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究智能体AI（Agentic AI）中多个有状态预动作门控（authority/资源/证据）的组合问题。核心贡献是形式化"修复引发的控制耦合"（remediation-induced control coupling）：当一个控制的修复操作改变了其他控制所评估的动作、证据或上下文时，会导致先前判断失效。论文提出remediate-and-regate协议恢复逐动作健全性，证明两个修复算子（证据替换和资源预算降级）不可交换，并通过确定性开放数据工件验证了CH1-CH8假设。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI系统同时受多种预动作控制管辖：权限门（SARC）、资源/碳预算门（Green SARC）、元数据证据有效性门（SARC-DQ）。现有研究已充分讨论了执行监控器的串行/并行组合以及策略组合算法（如deny-overrides），但尚未充分探索异构、有状态的预动作控制的组合问题——即一个控制的修复操作改变其他控制所评估的动作、证据或派生上下文时，导致先前判断失效并产生顺序依赖行为的问题。这不是组合本身的概念，而是异构控制语义、控制局部状态、动作/证据/上下文突变、修复排序、跨控制血缘、执行时重评估等因素共同作用下的特定组合问题。
AI.method:
1. **形式化建模**：定义动作a、上下文c(a)、证据集E(a)、门控Gi(a,c,E,si)→响应R={admit,substitute,degrade,escalate,block}，将R分为Exec={admit,substitute,degrade}和Held={escalate,block}两个语义类别。定义修复算子ρ为控制对违反行为的转换而非简单阻断。

2. **核心概念**：定义"修复引发的控制耦合"——两控制Gi和Gj在修复算子ρi下耦合，当存在可达动作a使得Gj(a)≠Gj(ρi(a))。构建耦合图C=(G,ℰ_C)。

3. **协议设计**：提出remediate-regate协议——Phase I评估证据门并应用ρsub后重算上下文；Phase II在重整后的(a',c(a'),E(a'))上重新评估所有门，返回Phase II响应的join。

4. **组合定理**：在A1（确定性）、A2（有界修复）、A3（幂等性）、A4（受控记录可采纳性）、A5（派生上下文重算）、A6（最终重门控）、A7（无并发状态突变）七个假设下，证明协议满足定义3（逐动作健全性）。

5. **线性族补偿引理**：给出加权聚合器f(s)=Σwisi保持veto的精确阈值条件——当且仅当τ>L*=W-min(w_i)时不存在被veto的profile被采纳。

6. **修复算子非交换性证明**：使用有限模型检查器在(qty, corrupted_cost, governed_cost, cost_budget, carbon_budget)的243点网格上对ρsub∘ρroute和ρroute∘ρsub两种顺序进行枚举验证。

7. **状态污染分析**：证明当前可采纳性不等同于未来引用可信度，受控证据缓冲区存在从声明未覆盖缺陷类别被投毒的风险，提出隔离窗口和滚动中位数两种缓解策略（仅降低风险，不消除）。

8. **实证验证**：在suite-demo确定性工件上组合三个已发布的Apache 2.0引擎（SARC、Green SARC、SARC-DQ）不变修改，使用UCI Online Retail开放数据加声明的合成元数据层和8类缺陷注入器，在30个预注册种子上进行假设检验。
AI.result:
**关键实验结果**：

1. **CH1（否决健全性）**：remediate-regate下零执行违规，30/30种子全部满足。

2. **CH2（单遍非健全性）**：S4场景下remediate-regate与single-pass在Exec/Held类别或带审计违规的方向上有分歧，单种子239个分歧决策，30种子均值207.5（95% CI [201.3, 213.7]）。

3. **CH3（确定性选择性）**：在干净、授权、预算内决策上的误拒率严格为0，30/30种子。

4. **CH4（覆盖诚实性）**：declared uncovered类（plausible_outlier、plausible_outlier_high）在所有门和组合中检测率为0，union_ok=True在30/30种子上成立。

5. **CH5（经验不安全补偿）**：在66权重向量×4阈值的264个网格单元中，加权聚合器最多补偿48个被veto的响应profile（98个Held中的）；经验层面30种子均值13775.1（95% CI [13753.5, 13796.6]）。

6. **CH6（缓冲区污染）**：W1工作流下plain策略每种子至少1次投毒替换（均值14.70，CI [13.21, 16.19]），两种缓解策略均严格降低；W2工作流由于样本量较小，部分种子零基线事件使严格降低声明不成立，诚实报告。

7. **CH7（多修复算子顺序依赖）**：243点网格中86点分歧，声明非合流（non-confluent）；离线网格探测150/200点分歧，固定种子不可漂移。

8. **CH8（稳健性）**：CH1-CH5在30种子全部满足，CH6在W1下满足、W2下不满足（诚实报告为不支持）。

**支持的命题/定理**：线性族补偿引理（n=3有限版经机器验证1064例，全部一致）；顺序不变性（Proposition 2，机器验证17151例）；单遍非健全性构造（Proposition 3，checked-scope-only）；remediate-regate健全性（Theorem 1，checked-scope-only）；单遍健全充分条件（Corollary 1，必要性已撤回）；证据集身份承诺（Proposition 4，checked-scope-only）；无虚构覆盖（Proposition 5，机器验证）。

**诚实声明**：该工件是机制演示而非生产普遍性声明；多个一般性声明经独立审查被限定为checked-scope-only；CH6的W2失败、W2工作流的样本量限制、所有先前声明中超出已验证范围的部分均如实报告。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的中心结论不是简单地主张多个治理门控应以保守方式聚合，而是指出：一旦一个治理控制被允许转换其他控制所消耗的动作、证据或上下文，之前的控制判断就成为其评估时所依据的治理对象版本的函数。正确的预动作治理因此需要显式语义来处理修复后的依赖判断失效与重计算。当存在多个修复算子时，其排序本身可以影响最终的被治理动作，使修复排序成为治理语义的一部分。当可采纳信息被提升到持久治理状态时，可采纳性与未来可信度必须同样被区分。这些结果为当前设定建立了一个有界的组合语义，同时将一般收敛性、并发性、委派以及任意有状态修复留给开放问题。论文明确声明不主张生产普遍性、不主张任意修复算子均不可交换、不主张组合保证完全安全性、不主张证据集哈希可重构源字节，仅以开放载荷数据和合成元数据层展示了机制存在性与所实现缓解策略的局部效果。

title: Selection, Recombination, or a Fresh Solve? A Candidate-Free Control for Single-Pass Test-Time Aggregation
comment: Accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning. 18 pages
summary: When every candidate is wrong, correct-candidate selection is unavailable, yet the aggregation call can still solve the problem afresh. A correct aggregate answer may therefore reflect recombination, fresh solving, or both. For efficient test-time reasoning, the relevant question is whether candidate context adds value beyond the additional generation pass. We introduce the missing candidate-free control under the same maximum output-token allowance and stratify by the number of correct candidates. Across AIME-2025 and HMMT-2025 with Qwen3-4B, candidate conditioning improves accuracy when multiple candidates are correct ($\Delta_{\mathrm{cand}}$(c2+) = +0.290), lowers accuracy when every candidate is wrong ($\Delta_{\mathrm{cand}}$(c0) = -0.123), and remains unresolved in the one-correct regime. The c2+ and c0 conclusions survive a conservative correction for the adaptive two-benchmark procedure. Under this counterfactual, the interpretation of all-wrong recovery reverses at this scale: conditioning on an all-wrong candidate pool lowers accuracy relative to a fresh solve. Original-format matching and placebo results characterize the failures descriptively but leave their mechanism unresolved. Within a separate structured intervention, explicit answer fields causally steer outputs toward their values; masking yields no measurable accuracy improvement, and equivalence with the original format was not established. The evidence is limited to one Qwen3-4B family, two mathematics benchmarks, first-answer-truncated candidate fragments, and single-pass prompted aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对单轮测试时聚合（test-time aggregation）方法，引入了一个缺失的"无候选对照"（candidate-free control），通过在Qwen3-4B模型和AIME-2025/HMMT-2025数学基准上的实验，发现在不同候选正确性区间下，候选上下文对准确率的影响呈现符号反转：当多个候选正确时提升准确率（+0.290），而当所有候选都错误时反而降低准确率（-0.123），这逆转了对"全错恢复率"的传统解读。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时聚合方法（如GSR、SSA、GenSelect）通常以"全错恢复率"作为聚合能力的证据，但当所有候选答案都错误时，选择机制不可用，正确答案只能来自重组（recombination）或重新求解（fresh solving）的混合。先前研究缺乏一个关键的对照实验——在相同输出token预算下，仅使用聚合阶段的生次调用但不提供候选上下文的"无候选生成"，因此无法分离候选条件化（candidate conditioning）相对于一次额外生次的净价值。
AI.method: 五个评估臂的实验设计：(1) AGGREGATE——接收问题+K个候选解；(2) NO-CANDIDATE——仅从问题重新求解（无候选对照）；(3) ANSWER-ONLY——仅接收候选答案不含推理；(4) VOTING——多数投票；(5) ORACLE——任何候选正确则标记。按候选正确数分层为c0（全错）、c1（恰好一个正确）、c2+（两个及以上正确）。所有生成臂共享相同的最大输出token预算（16384）。使用Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507及其推理训练变体，在AIME-2025和HMMT-2025各30题上评估。主要分析为问题级配对符号检验+Holm修正。另有一个构造性重组验证实验和结构化答案字段干预实验（FULL/MASKED/SUBSTITUTED）。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 符号反转——候选条件化在c2+时提升准确率+0.290（原始p=0.004），在c0时降低准确率-0.123（原始p=0.012），经保守自适应两阶段修正后c2+和c0结论仍显著；(2) c0失败中错误答案与显示的候选答案匹配率极高（AIME 0.845 vs 偶然率0.371，p<0.0001）；(3) 离题候选（placebo）也能复现大部分c0缺陷，提示匹配与话题相关性无关；(4) 结构化干预证实显式答案字段因果性地引导输出（+0.068，p=0.0425），但掩码答案字段未能恢复准确率；(5) 构造重组验证成功（AGGREGATE 0.767 vs 对照 0.000），证明harness能检测重组形式。
AI.conclusion: 单轮、无训练的测试时聚合在全错候选池中的"恢复率"不应被解读为聚合能力的证据，因为无候选重新求解在此区间下表现更优。候选上下文是"双刃剑"：在多个候选正确时有帮助，在全部错误时有害。本研究引入的无候选对照应成为测试时聚合评估的标准实践。作者强调未来工作需要：(1) 跨模型家族验证；(2) 训练或迭代方法是否产生正的重组净收益仍是开放问题；(3) 应分别报告候选增值准确率、边际延迟和端到端成本。

title: Vector Symbolic Policy Gradient
comment: Code available in this https URL
summary: We answer this question with Vector-Symbolic Policy Gradient (VSPG), a discrete-action actor that represents each action by a unit-norm hypervector and scores it by similarity to the encoded state. Under the standard softmax policy-gradient surrogate, we prove that its update is exactly advantage-weighted hypervector bundling followed by normalization, and therefore supports standard advantage estimators. We further show that each trained action hypervector is a fixed-size compressed kernel memory, storing an advantage-weighted kernel expansion over visited states and transferring evidence according to the encoder-induced similarity. This provides a concrete mechanism that can support sample-efficient learning without increasing inference-time memory. Finally, for bipolar action memories, we prove that greedy action selection is stable under random bit flips, with failure probability decaying exponentially in the hypervector dimension. VSPG thus connects VSA action memories, log-linear policy gradients, and kernel policy search while providing a quantitative robustness guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文提出向量符号策略梯度（VSPG），一种离散动作的actor方法，将每个动作表示为归一化的超向量，通过与编码状态的相似度评分。证明了softmax策略梯度更新等价于优势加权的超向量bundling加归一化，训练后的动作记忆形成固定大小的核展开，并在双极记忆下证明了对随机比特翻转的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的VSA-RL方法主要将超向量用于Q值近似（值函数方法，如QHD）或连续控制的actor-critic组件，缺乏将动作超向量直接参数化离散动作策略、并给出策略梯度的向量符号解释的工作。同时，部署在资源受限边缘设备上的RL策略面临量化与比特级故障导致的模型参数损坏问题，需要鲁棒的表示级解决方案。
AI.method: VSPG使用固定编码器ϕ（如RFF/FHRR/Basis）将观测映射为单位范数超向量s_t=ϕ(x_t)，动作超向量C_a初始化为单位范数，策略π(a|x)=softmax(τ·C_a^⊤ϕ(x))。更新规则为C←row-norm(C+ηΛ^⊤S)，其中Λ_{t,a}=A_t·τ(1[a=a_t]-π(a|x_t))。三组理论结果：(1) 命题1证明该更新恰为softmax策略梯度的投影梯度上升，等价于一阶黎曼梯度上升；(2) 命题2证明训练后的动作超向量是访问状态的advantage加权核展开c_a=β_a·c_a^(0)+∑_k α_{k,a}ϕ(x_k)，部署时无需存储样本；(3) 命题3证明双极动作记忆在比特翻转下的贪心动作选择失败概率以D·(1-2p)²·Δ(x)²/8指数衰减。支持任意优势估计器（GAE、REINFORCE等），并自然适用于Dec-POMDP多智能体设置。
AI.result: 在Classic Control（CartPole-v1、Acrobot-v1、LunarLander-v2）和MiniGrid（Empty-5x5、DoorKey-5x5/8x8）上，VSPG相比DNN和线性actor基线具有更快的收敛速度和竞争性的最终回报，显著优于值函数型VSA方法QHD（QHD在DoorKey-8x8上几乎学不到东西）。在SustainGym多智能体建筑控制（Hot-Dry、Warm-Humid气候）上，FHRR和RFF编码的VSPG取得最强回报（-7.28和-7.11），优于DNN（-13.41/-12.12）和Raw-Linear（-13.02/-10.92）。在后训练量化和比特翻转扰动下，VSPG的动作记忆比DNN和Raw-Linear actor退化更平缓。维度消融显示CartPole在D=1000后趋于饱和，DoorKey-8x8对维度更敏感；编码器消融显示Basis/FHRR产生一致的核邻域，而失败的RFF配置产生弱且不一致的匹配。
AI.conclusion: VSPG首次将VSA动作记忆、对数线性策略梯度和核策略搜索在离散动作RL中统一起来，提供了闭式策略梯度更新、固定大小的压缩核记忆表示，以及双极记忆比特翻转稳定性的指数型定量保证。实验证明其样本高效性、对模型损坏的优雅退化能力，是面向不可靠边缘系统部署的有前景的actor表示。未来工作将扩展到视觉驱动的决策和机器人任务。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Structure-Aware Numerical Reasoning in LLaMA 3.1 8B
summary: Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong numerical sequence modeling capabilities and show promise in time-series prediction. While LLMs display in-context learning capabilities, the mechanisms with which they accomplish time-series prediction remain unclear. Specifically, whether they truly understand the underlying structure, which at a minimum requires reasoning over first differences in the sequence of numbers. To study this, we investigate Llama 3.1-8B from a mechanistic interpretability point of view. Mechanistic interpretability is an emerging field concerned with the reverse engineering of the algorithms learned by neural networks such as LLMs. To assess Llamas' numerical sequence modeling capabilities and to facilitate our mechanistic interpretability analysis, we create a sequence modeling task that cannot be solved without picking up structural cues. Specifically, we sample n random numbers and repeat them with an offset. We find that Llama displays strong performance on our tasks suggesting that it can pick up on the underlying structure. To understand the mechanisms that allow it to do so, we perform probing experiments and activation patching based counterfactual analysis. Probing reveals that the model computes and stores first differences in its internal representations without explicit supervision, indicating that it tracks structural information about the sequence. Activation patching reveals that Llama retrieves the relevant first-difference with a mechanism similar to an induction circuit and subsequently adds it to the current value. Notably, our work represents one of the first studies to identify this form of concept induction in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过机制可解释性方法揭示了 LLaMA 3.1-8B 在数值序列外推任务中如何隐式学习结构化推理：模型内部计算并局部存储一阶差分（first differences），再通过类似归纳电路（induction circuit）的机制检索这些差分并将其与当前值相加，从而完成预测。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明 LLM 具备较强的数值序列建模和时间序列预测能力，但尚不清楚模型是通过记忆还是真正理解序列的潜在结构进行推理。若 LLM 确实具备对潜在结构（如一阶差分）的抽象推理能力，则这一能力将超越语言领域，对时间序列、像素空间关系、3D 数据结构等更广泛的场景具有重要意义。
AI.method: 1. 设计合成序列建模任务：采样 n 个随机数并以固定偏移重复，使得模式只有在差分后才会显现，且无法通过简单的 token 级复制/归纳头解决。2. 线性探针（linear probing）：在每一层训练 OLS 回归器，从特定 token 位置的隐藏状态中解码一阶差分和最终数值，并设置对照探针验证定位特异性。3. 激活补丁（activation patching）：将 clean 序列的隐藏状态和查询向量移植到 flat 序列（全部为 100）的 corrupt 运行中，测量对反事实标签概率的因果影响（ΔP）。4. 注意力头级别补丁：逐头移植最终 token 位置的输出，结合因果效应和 value-weighted attention 评分，识别功能关键 token（TI_t）。5. Key-swap 干预：在 clean 运行中交换第 25 和第 27 位置的 key 向量而保留 value 向量，以分离位置线索与差分内容对预测的贡献。
AI.result: 1. 性能：LLaMA 3.1-8B 在测试集（10,000 序列）上 MAE=4.2748，R²=0.9958，表明模型成功捕捉到差分模式。2. 探针结果：一阶差分从第 7 层起即可线性解码（R² > 0.8 并保持稳定），而最终数值在更深层中表征逐渐纠缠；对照探针表现显著较差，证明信息为位置特异性的。3. 激活补丁结果：在第 27 token 位置从第 15 层起出现显著的 ΔP 峰值，表明最终 token 的查询向量在该层后因果地与第 27 位置的隐藏状态交互——即模型在此处执行归纳和算术组合。4. 注意力头分析：最重要的 token 依次为 57（最终值）、33（重复差分模式起点）、27（被检索的差分）、55（计算最后差分的锚点）、25（匹配最终差分并启用下一差分检索）。5. Key-swap 结果：交换 key 后 ΔP_cf 上升、ΔP_gt 下降，但 ground truth 的绝对概率仍高于反事实概率，说明模型优先依赖差分内容而非位置/相位线索进行组合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了通用 LLM 在没有显式监督的情况下，能够涌现出对数值序列潜在结构的推理能力：识别模式、自发计算一阶差分、将其局部存储于隐藏表示中，并通过归纳式机制检索后与最终值相加。这些发现为 LLM 内部结构化推理提供了机制层面的证据，并启示未来将此类分析推广至更广泛的隐式结构推理任务（如程序合成、符号推理、时间与空间结构理解等）。同时，这也是首个在数值序列中识别出"对潜在结构进行归纳"这一概念诱导形式的工作。

title: Pedagogical AI in Mental Health: A Tri-Stream Fine-Tuned LLM Framework for Automated Clinical Supervision and Risk Triage
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted for publication in AICTC 2026, Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems, vol. 2165, Springer
summary: Modern mental healthcare faces a critical shortage of senior supervisory oversight, leading to a "supervision gap" where novice therapists manage high-stakes risks with delayed professional feedback. This paper proposes a new framework utilizing a fine-tuned Mistral-7B-instruct model as an automated "Supervisor-in-the-Loop" system. By leveraging 106 sessions from the DAIC-WOZ dataset, the model performs a tri-stream analysis: (1) Therapeutic Alliance tracking via semantic adherence, (2) Latent risk prediction using attention-weighted analytics, and (3) Supervisory Triage via a Dynamic Clinical Urgency Index (D-CUI). Our multi-modal VAL (Visual-Acoustic-Linguistic) framework achieves 95% technique identification accuracy [95% CI: 75.1%-99.9%], alliance assessment MAE of 0.105 on a 5-point scale [95% CI: 0.059-0.151], therapeutic fidelity alpha = 0.423, and mean D-CUI of 0.370 [95% CI: 0.322-0.419]. Training converged in 105 steps with 85.2% loss reduction on a single Tesla T4 GPU. The system reduces supervisory triage latency from 72 hours to real time (~10 seconds per session), enabling proactive intervention in high-risk cases. The system addresses the cold-start problem through Bayesian priors and implements timestamp-based modality synchronization for robust multi-modal fusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于微调Mistral-7B的三流多模态（视觉-声学-语言）框架，作为心理健康临床治疗中的"循环监督者"自动化系统，用于解决新手治疗师因高级督导不足而面临72小时监督延迟的"督导缺口"问题。系统通过动态临床紧迫性指数（D-CUI）实现实时风险分诊。
AI.motivation: 心理健康领域存在严重的督导缺口：督导与学员比例常超过1:12，传统每周一次的回顾式督导使高风险情况（如自杀意念披露）可能延迟72小时才被审查；现有LLM在心理健康领域的应用几乎全部面向患者端（聊天机器人、文档记录），而真正关乎临床质量保障的督导层被研究界忽视。
AI.method: 1. 架构：VAL三流框架——视觉流（OpenFace提取30fps面部动作单元AU）、声学流（COVAREP 100Hz提取F0标准差和VUV均值）、语言流（微调Mistral-7B-instruct，采用QLoRA 4-bit量化）；2. 时间对齐：以转录文本的话语边界为时钟，对音视频流进行mean-pooling对齐；3. 治疗保真度分析器：计算会话嵌入与临床手册嵌入的余弦相似度α；4. 动态临床紧迫性指数D-CUI = (w₁R + w₂S + w₃(1-E))·(1+Δφ)，引入治疗师经验因子E（含冷启动贝叶斯先验E₀=0.3）和情感波动Δφ；5. 不一致情感检测算法识别言语否认与面部痛苦的矛盾；6. 数据集：DAIC-WOZ中106个会话（80%训练/20%测试）。
AI.result: 在22个测试会话上：技术识别准确率95.5% [95% CI: 75.1%-99.9%]，联盟评估MAE=0.105 [0.059-0.151]，治疗保真度α=0.423，平均D-CUI=0.370 [0.322-0.419]，风险识别准确率63.6% [40.8%-84.6%]；训练在单块Tesla T4上经105步收敛于2小时44分钟，交叉熵损失降低85.2%；推理时间<15秒/会话；专家评审（5名持证督导，22份报告）临床相关性4.2/5.0，分诊适当性3.9/5.0，可操作性4.0/5.0，Cohen's κ=0.61。
AI.conclusion: 该系统是概念验证级别的成果：将分诊延迟从72小时降至近实时（~10-15秒），证明自动化筛查可解决督导瓶颈；其D-CUI纳入治疗师经验因子E的做法在临床风险公式中属首创；然而仍存在显著局限——测试集仅22个会话、技术仅覆盖两种（反思倾听与开放式提问）、数据为虚拟代理半结构化筛查访谈（非自然疗法）、CBT导向训练数据无法推广至其他治疗流派；投入临床部署前需扩展技术分类、纵向跟踪、自然疗法数据评估及偏见监测。

title: ERASE: EaRly bAckpropagation SchEdule for Faster Training of Modern Recommendation Systems
summary: Lightweight proxy models enable rapid experimentation without repeatedly training frontier-scale systems, but their small kernels often leave modern accelerators underutilized. Conventional training compounds this inefficiency by scheduling the forward and backward passes as disjoint phases, so spare capacity in one cannot be filled by work from the other. We reinterpret the detachment mechanism of Forward-Forward (FF) as a scheduling primitive: given a local objective, detaching a block's output removes downstream gradient dependencies, making its backward pass ready when its forward pass finishes. ERASE launches each detached subgraph's backward pass early on a separate CUDA stream, overlapping it with subsequent forward work. Execution trace on a lightweight transformer demonstrates this overlap and its limit: a kernel that saturates the device leaves no capacity for concurrency. On a large-scale click-through-rate model, detaching six dense subarchitectures improves training throughput by up to $9.51\%$ while keeping normalized entropy close to the baseline.

AI.tldr: ERASE将前向-前向(FF)算法中的detach机制重新解读为一种调度原语：通过切断块间梯度依赖，使每个detach子图的backward pass在其forward pass完成后即可立即启动，并在独立的CUDA流上与后续forward工作重叠，从而提升训练吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统训练吞吐量受加速器利用率制约。传统反向传播将forward和backward调度为不相交的两阶段，导致相互间的空闲容量无法被填补。这一问题在轻量级代理模型（如NanoChat）上尤为突出——模型规模刻意设计得很小，kernel无法饱和加速器，硬件资源未被充分利用。需要一种调度策略来提高MFU（模型FLOPs利用率）。
AI.method: 1) 利用FF风格的detach机制切割块间数据依赖，使每个块的backward在forward和局部目标完成后即可启动；2) 使用独立的CUDA流和事件强制执行剩余依赖，使block b的backward与block b+1的forward并行执行；3) 采用ThreadPoolExecutor进行非阻塞派发，避免主线程CPU调度阻塞；4) 使用CUDA Graphs捕获子图，固定跨rank的launch order，避免staggering导致的straggler问题。
AI.result: 在NanoChat（单A100）上的执行trace验证了overlap模式：当kernel未饱和时backward可与forward重叠，但fused multi-head attention backward kernel因占用所有SM而独占设备，无并发空间。在CTR模型（8×H100）上detach 6个密集子架构：非阻塞+CUDA Graphs配置（FUP=False）提升7.38%吞吐量，NE差距约1.38%；blocking+FUP=True配置达到最高9.51%吞吐量增益。30层MLP+MNIST实验显示compute-matched反向时间减少58%、总batch时间减少30%。
AI.conclusion: ERASE成功将FF风格detach重新用作调度原语：通过切割块间依赖使各backward pass在其forward完成后即可就绪，实现独立流上的overlap，同时保留子图内精确梯度且无需FF的goodness目标。在CTR模型上ERASE以确定性跨rank集合通信顺序获得5–9%的p90 QPS提升，NE代价极小。核心发现是overlap仅在硬件未饱和时有效，对轻量级代理模型是天然的目标场景。

title: Physics-Unrolled Neural Operator for Wireless Field Modeling
summary: Radio maps are essential for wireless decision-making tasks such as access-point placement, coverage planning, and localization, but their fine spatial details are governed by complex propagation effects and are costly to simulate accurately. Machine learning offers a path to high-fidelity radio-map prediction without running expensive high-fidelity simulations for every scene. However, generating high-quality training labels at scale is also difficult: the affordable labels come from finite-ray simulations, which are richer than low-fidelity inputs but carry residual Monte Carlo noise. We address this challenge with Physics-Unrolled Hybrid Neural Operator (PU-HNO), a three-stage cascade that predicts high-fidelity indoor radio maps from low-fidelity ray-tracing outputs and scene priors by progressively capturing reflection, diffraction, and scattering effects, rather than treating radio maps as generic images. We prove that, under conditionally unbiased label noise, the model can learn stable propagation structure and outperform its own training labels. Experiments across diverse floorplans show that PU-HNO outperforms image-to-image baselines, wireless learning models, and monolithic neural operators across both image-quality and wireless deployment metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PU-HNO（Physics-Unrolled Hybrid Neural Operator），一种三阶段级联的神经算子架构，能够从低保真射线追踪输出和场景先验预测高保真室内无线电地图。该方法将无线传播物理过程分解为反射、衍射和散射三个渐进式精化阶段，在包含条件无偏标签噪声的训练设定下，理论上可证明模型能学习到比训练标签更接近高保真参考的预测结果。
AI.motivation: 高保真无线电地图对无线接入点部署、覆盖规划和定位至关重要，但其精细空间细节由复杂的多径传播效应（反射、衍射、散射）决定，仿真成本高昂。机器学习虽能避免对每个场景运行昂贵的仿真，但大规模生成高质量训练标签同样困难——可负担的标签来自有限射线仿真，虽比低保真输入丰富，但残留蒙特卡洛噪声。现有方法将无线电地图视为通用图像进行图像到图像学习，容易平滑掉多径引起的局部尖锐变化，而这些变化对覆盖和规划至关重要。核心问题是：机器学习能否将低成本、有噪声的无线电地图仿真转化为高保真预测？
AI.method: PU-HNO采用三阶段残差神经算子级联，每阶段专注特定传播机制：(1) 第一阶段（镜面精化）结合全局谱算子𝒢、小波路径𝒲和反射感知局部算子ℒ_refl，恢复大尺度覆盖结构；(2) 第二阶段（衍射精化）结合方向选择性衍射算子𝒟_θ和图神经算子𝒩_K，并通过自适应尺寸场s*门控聚焦于边缘驱动效应；(3) 第三阶段（散射精化）使用由几何/材质条件生成的局部卷积核捕捉短程细尺度波动。训练采用复合损失：阶段匹配的Huber损失（置信度调制）、距离调制Sobolev梯度损失（保持空间过渡）和传输特征对齐损失（对齐残差更新与传播结构）。输入包括低保真射线图u、几何/材质先验g和坐标先验c，通过共享编码器形成初始潜场。理论上证明在条件无偏标签噪声（𝔼[ε|X]=0）下，经验风险最小化可学习稳定传播结构，并给出零样本去噪定理。
AI.result: 在多种室内平面图上的实验表明，PU-HNO在无线和图像质量指标上均优于图像到图像基线（CNN、U-Net、ResNet、ViT）、无线学习模型（NeRF²、RadioUNet、GeneRT、WiGATr）和单一神经算子（FNO、TFNO、UNO、SFNO、CoDA-NO、WNO）。具体地：Outage F1达0.82（训练标签仅0.172），RMSE降至3.47 dB，SSIM达0.928，LPIPS最低0.229，fading ratio接近理想值1.0（1.013），尾误差降至0.10。关键发现是PU-HNO预测比其训练标签（IF-GT）更接近高保真参考（HF-GT），证明零样本去噪有效。消融研究表明移除语义先验使Outage F1崩溃至0.001；移除Sobolev或Huber单独监督则降至0.11-0.13；分阶段架构逐步提升性能（仅反射→加衍射→加散射：Outage F1从0.21→0.40→0.82）。OOD泛化测试中，在房间数和家具数偏移的测试组上RMSE保持3.31-3.89 dB。在10,000 m²的接入点部署案例研究中，PU-HNO实现92 Mbps吞吐量，而CNN仅16 Mbps。下游AP部署分析显示，PU-HNO仅需1个补救AP（$1,500成本），而CNN需3个（$4,500），GeneRT和WNO各需4个（$6,000）。对零均值噪声（IID、异方差、空间相关）鲁棒，但对系统偏置噪声失败（RMSE升至12.06 dB）。
AI.conclusion: PU-HNO证明了将物理结构对齐的架构与传播感知损失相结合，可从不完美的仿真标签中学习高保真无线电地图预测，且预测精度优于训练标签本身。该工作将经典单图像去噪结果扩展至跨多物理场景的算子学习，确立了条件无偏噪声模型下的零样本去噪定理。主要局限性包括：依赖精确的几何/障碍物/材质先验；仅预测RSS标量（不建模相位、信道脉冲响应或MIMO矩阵）；评估限于室内单发射机固定天线假设；监督和评估均基于射线追踪，真实部署需测量数据校准。未来工作方向包括连续材质属性建模、复数值信道预测、多发射机干扰研究和sim-to-real自适应。

title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with multi-turn tool-calling capabilities is essential for building autonomous agents. However, progress is fundamentally limited by the reliance on full-length trajectory imitation. For tasks involving multiple order-independent sub-goals, the optimal solution space forms a vast combinatorial diamond lattice. Forcing this rich topology into monolithic trajectories causes a severe topological collapse, indiscriminately penalizing valid alternative explorations and severely degrading policy diversity. To address this, we propose DART-SD (Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from global forcing to topology-guided localized correction. DART-SD first models the execution process as a converging Interaction-State Transition Graph (ISTG), faithfully capturing the inherent diamond topology of successful and failed exploratory paths. During autonomous rollouts, the framework identifies the Critical Topological Breakpoint (CTB) and retrieves success-supported recovery references. Finally, we introduce a progressive self-distillation paradigm through CTB-guided localized supervision, ensuring that the training loss is calculated exclusively on the generated recovery steps while strictly protecting the valid reasoning prefix from destructive gradient updates. Experiments on complex multi-turn tool-calling benchmarks demonstrate that DART-SD significantly outperforms traditional full-trajectory baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DART-SD框架，针对多轮工具调用智能体训练中存在的"拓扑坍缩"问题，通过构建交互状态转移图（ISTG）捕捉顺序无关子目标形成的钻石拓扑结构，识别关键拓扑断点（CTB），并通过CTB引导的局部监督进行渐进式自蒸馏，避免了对有效推理前缀的破坏性梯度更新。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体训练范式（SFT全局模仿、RL稀疏信号）将多轮工具调用过程视为线性轨迹，忽略了顺序无关子目标形成的钻石拓扑结构。这种"拓扑坍缩"会导致：对有效替代探索的无差别惩罚、策略多样性下降、信用分配不当（GRPO等均匀分配奖励会错误惩罚失败轨迹中的有效步骤）。核心问题是刚性线性假设与多轮交互固有图结构之间的根本错位。
AI.method: 方法包含四个核心组件：(1) 信息原子抽象——将工具响应规范化为任务特定的信息原子集K_x，通过确定性阶段（识别错误或占位响应）和语义阶段（联合判定语义等价性）实现跨工具响应识别；(2) 交互状态转移图（ISTG）构建——定义状态X_t=(I_t, U_t)为累积信息原子集与无用操作多重集，构建有向多重图G_x，包含主节点（信息获取）和辅助节点（无用探索），捕捉顺序无关路径的发散与汇聚；(3) 关键拓扑断点（CTB）识别——定义经验可达区域R_x^+（预算过滤后的成功可达节点），对学生状态进行类型特定投影（主节点按信息集子集关系、辅助节点按父节点和操作数匹配），CTB定义为从可投影到不可投影的首次转移；(4) CTB引导的局部监督与渐进自蒸馏——通过特权上下文检索（AugGen）生成恢复步骤，损失掩码仅作用于CTB之后的助手响应令牌，保护有效前缀，迭代5轮实现渐进能力扩展。
AI.result: 在5个工具调用基准（FTRL、BFCL、ToolHop、τ-bench、RoTBench）上使用Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B两种规模进行评估，DART-SD均取得最优平均性能（Qwen3-4B: 39.17 vs SFT 37.62；Qwen3-8B: 45.58 vs SFT 41.64）。关键发现：(1) 学生模型在FTRL、ToolHop、τ-bench上超越教师模型；(2) 渐进训练中成功轨迹的工具调用数从4.23降至3.55，比黄金参考（4.02）更高效；(3) 失败轨迹的CTB位置从0.348推进至1.452，表明有效前缀持续延长；(4) 通用能力（IFEval、AIME24/25、MMLU）平均分从43.92提升至49.89，超越SFT；(5) 组件消融验证SD→CTB→渐进SFT→ISTG的逐步增益（最终45.66 vs 基线23.48）。
AI.conclusion: DART-SD建立了基于交互状态拓扑而非刚性轨迹模仿的智能体蒸馏新范式。通过ISTG建模钻石拓扑、CTB定位能力边界、局部监督保护有效前缀、渐进迭代扩展能力边界，该框架在工具调用效率、泛化能力和通用推理保留方面均优于现有蒸馏与强化学习方法。研究表明结构感知的智能体训练（基于图表示与拓扑引导监督）比线性模仿更适合长程推理与决策任务，为未来结构感知智能体训练研究提供了新方向。

title: Evaluating and Explaining Prompt Sensitivity of LLMs Using Interactions
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 46 pages, 48 figures
summary: The remarkable capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are often undermined by their instability. Even subtle and semantically irrelevant changes in prompts can cause dramatic fluctuations in performance, a phenomenon known as prompt sensitivity. Previous studies typically evaluate prompt sensitivity by comparing the LLM's final outputs when prompts change. However, such coarse-grained metrics fail to explain the internal reasons for prompt sensitivity. In this paper, we introduce interactions as a fine-grained tool to analyze prompt sensitivity of LLMs. Specifically, we decompose the output score of the LLM into a set of interactions. Each interaction represents a nonlinear relationship involving a set of input variables. We discover that subtle changes to prompts can trigger severe instability in interactions, even when the outputs of the LLM remain the same. To this end, we propose an Interaction-based Prompt Sensitivity (IPS) metric by quantifying changes in interactions when we introduce subtle changes to prompts. We apply the IPS metric to 50 open-source LLMs and uncover four factors that reduce the prompt sensitivity of LLMs, including supervised fine-tuning, increased model scales, dense architectures, and few-shot learning. More crucially, we discover a common mechanism by which these four factors reduce prompt sensitivity: all four factors tend to reduce the prompt sensitivity of low-order interactions (i.e., interactions involving few input variables).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于交互作用（Interactions）的细粒度度量方法IPS（Interaction-based Prompt Sensitivity），用于评估大语言模型（LLMs）的提示敏感性。通过将LLM的输出分数分解为一组交互作用，揭示了传统输出级度量无法捕捉的内部不稳定性，并在50个开源LLM上发现了影响稳定性的四个因素及其共同机制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究评估LLM的提示敏感性（prompt sensitivity）时，通常只比较最终输出的变化（如准确率或输出一致性），这种粗粒度指标无法解释LLM内部产生敏感性波动的原因。作者希望从更细粒度的视角分析提示敏感性，并探究哪些因素能降低这种敏感性及其内在机制。
AI.method: 1. 将LLM的标量输出分数分解为一系列交互作用（interactions），每个交互作用代表一组输入变量之间的非线性关系；2. 利用博弈论中的通用匹配性质（Universal Matching Property）证明交互作用可作为LLM内部推理模式的忠实解释；3. 提出IPS度量，通过量化提示变化前后显著交互作用的变化来评估提示敏感性；4. 将交互作用按阶数（涉及输入变量的数量）分为低阶、中阶和高阶，分析不同因素对各阶交互作用敏感性的影响。
AI.result: 在50个开源LLM（涵盖6个模型家族）上的实验发现四个降低提示敏感性的因素：（1）监督微调（指令/聊天模型比基础模型更稳定）；（2）增大模型规模；（3）密集架构优于MoE架构；（4）少样本学习优于零样本学习。关键发现是：即使LLM最终输出不变，内部交互作用仍可能严重不稳定。进一步分析表明，这四个因素主要通过稳定低阶交互作用来降低整体提示敏感性，而对本身最不稳定的高阶交互作用影响有限。在开放生成任务和更复杂的提示扰动（语义复述、指令重排）上的额外实验验证了结论的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: IPS作为一种细粒度度量方法，能揭示传统输出级度量无法发现的LLM内部不稳定性。监督微调、增大规模、密集架构和少样本学习均能降低提示敏感性，其共同机制是稳定低阶交互作用。未来的LLM设计应致力于增强对稳定低阶交互作用的依赖，或着力降低高阶交互作用的不稳定性。

title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
summary: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks, an assistant model writes assistance text for a standardized lower-capacity worker model, which produces the deliverable. In automation mode, the assistant produces the output directly. Outputs are scored through blind pairwise comparisons by an LLM judge panel with task-specific rubrics, replicated across ten runs. Rankings across the two regimes are only modestly correlated, and the automation winner loses augmentation on five of seven tasks. Assistance is not reliably positive. The unaided worker outranks every assisted condition on three tasks, and only one model's guidance beats no guidance on average. These results suggest that automation ability is an incomplete proxy for assistance quality, motivating benchmarks that evaluate models according to the roles they play in human-AI and multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CentaurBench框架,在七个真实工作任务上同时评估LLM的"自动化"(独立完成任务)与"增强"(指导较弱工作者)两种能力。通过固定GPT-3.5-Turbo作为执行者、采用盲测两两比较与LLM评审团,研究发现自动化与增强排名相关性仅为0.48且不显著;在7个任务中有5个两种模式下的最佳模型不一致;无指导的基线在三个任务上反而优于所有被辅助的条件,表明自动化能力并非增强能力的有效代理,模型选择应按角色而非通用排行榜进行。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准几乎都聚焦于模型的"自动化"能力(即模型独立完成任务的输出质量),但现实中模型更多地扮演"教练/助手"角色,辅助人类或其他LLM完成任务。经济学领域已呼吁"半人马式评估"(centaur evaluation),将人类与AI作为一个整体进行评估,但尚无研究在多个职业领域、同一任务集上系统比较同一组模型的自动化与增强能力。"最优秀的选手未必是最优秀的教练"这一假设缺乏跨任务、跨模型的实证检验。
AI.method: 构建统一框架,在两种使用模式下评估10个前沿LLM:(1)自动化模式——模型端到端独立完成任务;(2)增强模式——模型仅为固定的GPT-3.5-Turbo工作者生成200–250字的"过程导向型脚手架"(需求检查→计划结构→自检清单),禁止提供具体内容。七个真实职业任务涵盖结构化规划(餐饮、旅行)、专业分析(市场趋势、运筹学、税务)与人类交互(咨询、辅导)。评估采用四名LLM评审的盲测两两比较,使用任务专属微评分量表与通用维度,实施leave-one-family-out屏蔽以减少自我偏好,整个管道在10次独立运行中重复。最终通过胜率→秩排序→秩的秩聚合形成跨模式、跨任务的排名矩阵。
AI.result: 1)模型层面自动化与增强排名Spearman相关系数仅ρ=0.48(p=0.187,统计上不显著),任务层面相关性从ρ=-0.04(旅行规划)到ρ=0.85(税务)差异巨大;2)GPT-5-Mini在两种模式下平均均最优,但在7个任务中有5个,自动化赢家并非增强赢家;3)无任何辅助的GPT-3.5-Turbo基线在三个任务(运筹学、税务、旅行规划)中排名第一,平均增强秩3.79仅次于GPT-5-Mini的3.66——大多数模型的辅助反而降低了工作者产出;4)出现显著且稳定的角色反转:Claude-Opus-4.8在市场趋势任务上自动化排名第一(2.05)但增强最差(8.15),GPT-4.1在咨询任务上恰好相反;5)质性分析提炼出三类有效辅助特征:超越提示的具体性、显式结构与排序、不与任务目标相悖。LLM评审一致性:原始一致率71.0%,Krippendorff α=0.414,选择-评分一致率99.7%。
AI.conclusion: 自动化与增强是两种不同的能力维度,自动化基准无法替代增强评估。模型选择应按"角色×任务"联合决定,而非依赖单一通用排行榜。该框架对组织部署AI具有直接意义:执行型任务优先看自动化能力,而嵌入专家工作流的辅助型应用则应单独评估增强能力。局限性包括依赖LLM评审而非人类专家、单一工作者模型、单一交互回合、任务集规模有限。未来工作应扩展至多回合交互、变换工作者模型、增加任务多样性,并通过领域专家进行外部验证。总体而言,该研究将AI评估范式从"模型能独立完成什么"扩展到"模型能让其他代理做得更好什么",为人机协作与多智能体系统的模型选型提供了方法论基础。

title: Performance Drift Detection in Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) for IoT Environments
summary: Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) is a powerful cloud paradigm enabling data-driven intelligent applications in Internet of Things (IoT) environments, widely adopted across healthcare, smart homes, and industry due to its cost-effectiveness. However, the dynamic nature of IoT frequently alters data distributions, affecting MLaaS stability, while periodic MLaaS updates further introduce performance drift. Unlike traditional ML systems, MLaaS clients operate as black-box users without access to internal data or parameters, making drift detection particularly challenging. To address this, we propose a novel MLaaS Performance Drift Detection framework for IoT environments. The framework first employs an MLaaS extraction model that learns service behavior from input-output pairs and identifies prediction-influenced features. Building on this, the proposed MLaaS Performance Drift Detection (MPDD) model jointly captures variations in input data and MLaaS behavior. We further design an Adaptive-Temporal Performance Drift Detection Mechanism (APDDM) that dynamically adjusts monitoring frequency based on behavioral and data variations, enabling timely drift detection for effective service management. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that MPDD achieves up to 22-25% accuracy improvement over baseline drift detection methods. APDDM provides an average accuracy gain of approximately 4% and reduces the miss detection rate by around 9% compared to fixed-interval monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文针对物联网环境中黑盒机器学习即服务（MLaaS）的性能漂移检测问题，提出了一种无需依赖真实标签的MPDD框架。该框架通过MLaaS提取模型近似服务行为，结合Fréchet数据漂移分数（FDDS）与MLaaS感知漂移暴露分数（MDES）联合判别真实漂移与伪漂移，并设计自适应时序检测机制（APDDM）动态调整监测频率。
AI.motivation: 在物联网环境中，MLaaS客户端作为黑盒用户无法访问内部数据或参数，且真实标签采集成本高昂、难以持续获取。同时，物联网数据分布的动态变化和MLaaS提供商的周期性更新会引发性能漂移，而传统基于错误率的方法需要真实标签，基于输入分布的方法又无法区分伪漂移（即输入分布变化但不影响预测行为的漂移），因此亟需一种能在黑盒设置下无监督且高效检测性能漂移的机制，并解决固定监测间隔导致的过敏感或欠敏感问题。
AI.method: 1) **MLaaS提取模型**：利用输入-输出对训练轻量级CART决策树近似黑盒MLaaS行为，通过逐特征扰动计算特征重要性向量；2) **Fréchet数据漂移分数（FDDS）**：基于均值与协方差差异度量基线窗口与当前窗口之间的分布变化；3) **MLaaS感知漂移暴露分数（MDES）**：将特征重要性与FDDS加权聚合，自动设定阈值μ+βσ以区分真实漂移与伪漂移；4) **自适应时序检测机制（APDDM）**：基于缓冲区漂移比例与连续漂移/稳定计数器动态调整窗口大小，平衡过敏感与欠敏感；5) 在5个真实数据集（HAR、Electricity、Weather、Poker、Airline）上使用SEA生成器模拟4类漂移场景，与ADWIN、MMD、D3、STUDD、SCSD进行对比实验。
AI.result: MPDD在所有数据集上的检测准确率（伪漂移0.88-0.91，真实漂移0.69-0.99）均优于基线方法，相比基线提升约22-25%的准确率；MLaaS提取模型保真度约95.2%，对MPDD/APDDM性能影响极小（偏差0-2.58个百分点）；APDDM相比固定间隔MPDD平均准确率提升约4%，漏检率降低约9%，在Poker数据集上将漏报从640降至160（降低75%），在Airline数据集上将漏报从80降至32（降低60%）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在无法访问真实标签和模型内部参数的黑盒MLaaS场景下，能够有效区分真实性能漂移与伪漂移，并通过自适应监测频率实现及时且稳定的漂移检测，为成本敏感和安全关键的物联网领域（如智能医疗、工业物联网、智能交通）提供了可靠的MLaaS性能管理工具。

title: MorphoGP: A Nonparametric Framework for Predicting Equilibrium Beach Profiles Under Tidal Influence
summary: The prediction of equilibrium beach profiles under tidal influence is of fundamental importance for sustainable coastal development, informing shoreline protection strategies and managing coastal ecosystems under changing environmental conditions. However, it remains challenging due to the highly nonlinear interactions among wave, tide, and sedimentary processes. Traditional empirical and numerical models often exhibit limited adaptability across diverse coastal environments, with especially pronounced limitations in beach systems where tidal processes are important . To improve data-driven prediction under these conditions, this study proposes MorphoGP, a unified category-specific Gaussian process framework for predicting equilibrium beach profiles (EBPs) under tidal influence. The framework first introduces a ContourCluster model based on contrastive learning to classify tide-influenced beach morphologies automatically. Within each morphological category, a specialized Gaussian process expert learns statistical associations between environmental descriptors including waves, tides, and sediments and the beach profile's shape. A Gating Net then integrates the outputs of all experts through a probabilistic weighting mechanism to produce the final prediction. Evaluated on data from over 180 beach profiles from tide-influenced coasts along the Chinese coast, MorphoGP achieves improved predictive performance compared with conventional and deep learning models, reducing the test RMSE by about 59.3\% compared with the best baseline and achieving a final RMSE of 0.297 m. The proposed framework provides a physically informed, data-driven tool for equilibrium beach-profile prediction under tidal influence and coastal management, while stronger process-level physical coupling remains an important direction for future development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MorphoGP框架，一种基于高斯过程的非参数建模方法，用于在潮汐影响下预测平衡海滩剖面（EBP）。该框架结合了基于对比学习的轮廓聚类（ContourCluster）模块、类别特异性的高斯过程专家和概率门控网络，能够自动识别潮汐影响海滩的形态类别，并在每个类别内学习环境驱动因子（波浪、潮汐、沉积物）与剖面形状之间的统计关联。在中国海岸183个海滩的222个剖面数据上，MorphoGP将测试RMSE降至0.297 m，相比最佳基线降低约59.3%。
AI.motivation: 平衡海滩剖面的预测对于海岸保护与生态系统管理至关重要，但在潮汐影响显著的环境中（如大潮差海岸），传统的经验模型（如Dean/Bruun型功率律剖面）和基于过程的数值模型（如Delft3D、XBeach）适应性有限，因为波浪-潮汐-沉积物过程之间存在高度非线性相互作用。现有机器学习方法多采用单一全局模型，无法捕捉多形态共存的特性，且大多基于少量海滩的时间序列数据，缺少跨区域的系统验证。因此需要一个能够显式处理多形态异质性、量化预测不确定性并保持可解释性的框架。
AI.method: 方法分为三个核心组件：（1）ContourCluster模块：通过对海滩剖面的候选shapelet子序列进行基于Transformer编码器的嵌入表示，并采用三元组损失（triplet loss）结合局部几何描述符进行对比学习，再通过k-means聚类将剖面划分为K个形态类别；（2）类别特异性高斯过程专家：对每个形态类别使用带有ARD（自动相关性确定）平方指数核的高斯过程GP，学习从环境驱动因子到剖面高程的映射；（3）Gating Net门控网络：以MLP参数化输入相关的混合权重，结合GP边际似然（证据项）与上下文logit，通过softmax生成空间变化的专家权重，对所有专家输出进行概率加权融合，实现不确定性量化。训练目标为最大化条件混合对数似然。
AI.result: 在中国海岸183个海滩（涵盖大潮差、中潮差和小潮差环境）的222个剖面数据上进行五折交叉验证：MorphoGP达到R²=0.942±0.022，RMSE=0.297±0.041 m，MAE=0.209±0.038 m，显著优于KNN、线性回归、MLP、随机森林、SVR、Transformer、Bruun型和指数型等基线模型（最优基线RF仅R²=0.654）；消融实验验证了ContourCluster模块、GP预测器和RBF-ARD核的必要性（移除ContourCluster后R²降至0.664，随机分组降至0.612）；最优聚类数K=5（轮廓系数0.4235）；区域留出评估显示预测不确定性在域偏移时合理升高；ARD特征相关性分析表明年平均大潮差、潮汐范围及主导波向频率对预测贡献最大，凸显潮汐参数的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: MorphoGP提供了一种物理信息引导的、数据驱动的概率框架，用于在潮汐影响下进行平衡海滩剖面预测，其主要贡献在于：基于形态的类别划分、GP专家的概率预测以及空间变化的专家聚合机制。该框架展示了强大的预测性能、不确定性量化和可解释性。局限性在于：（1）预测的是低潮调查的间带剖面，并非完整的活性海滩剖面（从前滨沙丘到闭合深度）；（2）作为数据驱动框架，不显式解析波浪-潮汐-沉积物动力学的完整物理过程；（3）当前区域留出评估仅反映中等程度的域偏移，更强的域外泛化仍需更多地理和形态动力多样性数据集来验证。未来工作将聚焦于连续时空剖面演化、引入更强物理约束以及跨区域数据集扩展。

title: From Storage to Access: Verifiable Activation of Parametric Knowledge in LLMs via Explicit Priming and Implicit Reasoning
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) encode rich factual knowledge in their parameters, reliably recalling and verifying such knowledge remains a key bottleneck in factual question answering. Existing end-to-end methods entangle knowledge elicitation with reasoning, making it difficult to determine whether correct answers arise from parametric knowledge or the input context. To address this challenge, we propose VAKE (Verifiable Activation of Parametric KnowledgE), a two-stage reinforcement-learning framework that externalizes latent parametric knowledge through explicit Priming and transfers the acquired elicitation capability to implicit Reasoning. Given a query and an insufficient retrieved subgraph, the Priming policy explicitly inserts bridging triples as verifiable evidence, with supervision provided by rewards derived from answers generated by a separate frozen model over the augmented subgraph. Building on the policy learned during Priming, the Reasoning stage trains the model to answer from the original input, testing whether the capability acquired through explicit knowledge elicitation transfers to implicit reasoning. Experiments across seven benchmarks and models from 3B to 14B show that VAKE consistently outperforms standard baselines, including when transferring directly from HotpotQA to OOD datasets. LLM-based evaluation further shows that over 80% of the inserted triples provide factual bridging knowledge not derivable from the retrieved context, while more than half elicit knowledge inaccessible through direct prompting. These results suggest that VAKE activates latent parametric knowledge rather than copying the input context or memorizing dataset-specific associations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VAKE（Verifiable Activation of Parametric KnowledgE），一种两阶段强化学习框架，用于显式激活 LLM 中存储但难以访问的参数化知识。该框架通过 Priming 阶段让策略向检索子图中插入可验证的桥接三元组，并由冻结的应答模型提供奖励信号；再通过 Reasoning 阶段将习得的知识激活能力迁移到隐式思维链推理中，实现在不插入三元组的情况下直接问答。
AI.motivation: 尽管 LLM 在参数中编码了丰富的事实知识，但这些知识常处于"已存储但不可访问"的状态，导致事实问答中召回失败。现有端到端方法将知识激活与推理纠缠在一起，难以判断正确答案究竟来源于参数知识还是输入上下文。此外，标准基于准确率的评估混淆了存储失败与访问失败，而二者的干预方式不同。因此需要一种可观测、可归因的知识激活方法，将激活过程从推理中解耦出来。
AI.method: VAKE 包含两阶段，均使用 GRPO 优化。第一阶段 Priming：策略 π_θ 基于查询 q 和稀疏检索子图 R(q) 生成桥接三元组集合 I，由冻结的应答模型 M_0 在 R(q)∪ I 上生成答案并提供基于答案质量的奖励（EM+F1 加权），使 I 成为唯一可变量，从而实现可观测、可归因的知识激活。第二阶段 Reasoning：以 Priming 策略初始化，模型直接从 (q, R(q)) 生成答案并接受相同奖励训练，将显式激活能力迁移到隐式 CoT 推理。奖励由 QA 质量项与格式约束项组成，并对严重格式错误施加惩罚以确保可解析性。检索使用浅层 BFS+K=10 三元组的稀疏子图，并刻意剔除含黄金答案的三元组以保证不充分性。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 上、跨 7 个基准（3 个多跳 ID、4 个 OOD 含 Bamboogle、NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA）的实验显示：VAKE 在 ID 和 OOD 上均稳定优于 Self-Ask、RECITE、Unlock、GRPO 等基线；VAKE-P（仅 Priming）在 ID 平均上超最强非推理基线 2.2–2.4 分；完整 VAKE 在 HotpotQA→OOD 迁移中平均提升达 1.8–2.4 分。归因分析表明超过 80% 的插入三元组源自参数知识而非检索子图，掩码探针显示 VAKE-P 在尾实体复现上超过 72B 基座模型。在 GSM8K/IFEval/AIME/MMLU 上能力未退化，且从 3B 到 14B 跨规模均稳定。
AI.conclusion: VAKE 将事实问答定位为参数知识访问问题而非存储问题，通过两阶段框架将显式知识激活与推理解耦，提供了可观测、可归因的激活证据。Priming 阶段引入的桥接三元组主要暴露了直接提示无法触及的参数知识，Reasoning 阶段则将其能力内化为隐式推理，并与推理优化互补。该方法可作为现有后训练流水线中 RL 补充，与 SFT 知识激活和标准 GRPO 推理优化无缝衔接。

title: Denoising-Aware Inversion: Revealing Privacy Risks in Noise-Protected Text Embeddings
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted by IEEE ICDM 2026
summary: Dense text embeddings are widely used in data mining, retrieval, and downstream machine learning systems due to their compact and semantically rich representations, but recent embedding inversion attacks have shown that they can expose substantial information about the original text, leading to serious privacy leakage risks. A common defense is to release perturbed embeddings by adding Gaussian noise, which is simple yet effective against standard inversion attacks and does not significantly degrade embedding utility for downstream tasks. However, it remains unclear whether such noise-protected embeddings are sufficiently safe against adaptive attackers that explicitly account for the perturbation process. In this paper, we study text embedding inversion in a noise-protected setting, where the attacker can observe only noisy embeddings and has no access to clean embedding targets. We first analyze why existing generative inversion methods fail under this setting and identify a "Double Noise Trap", which fundamentally prevents standard generative inversion models from achieving high-quality reconstruction. To address this challenge, we propose DAEI, a denoising-aware embedding inversion pipeline that combines a residual denoising autoencoder with generative text inversion where the denoiser is trained in an unsupervised manner using Stein's unbiased risk estimate to enable denoising from noisy observations alone. Extensive experiments show that DAEI achieves approximately 154\% relative improvement in BLEU over the existing generative inversion baseline, while also improving token-level F1 and ROUGE-L by 32--60\%. The promising inversion performance of DAEI challenges the prevailing assumption that simple Gaussian perturbation is sufficient to prevent sensitive information leakage from embedding representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DAEI（Denoising-Aware Embedding Inversion）攻击框架，证明在高斯噪声保护的文本嵌入场景下，仅靠加噪防御不足以阻止隐私泄露。DAEI 通过 SURE 无监督去噪自编码器与生成式反演相结合，在无干净嵌入的严苛威胁模型下恢复原始文本，BLEU 相对提升约 154%，F1/ROUGE-L 提升 32–60%。
AI.motivation: 密集文本嵌入广泛用于检索与下游任务，但易泄露原文隐私。当前主流防御是在嵌入上叠加高斯噪声（σ=0.01），其计算开销低且能有效抑制标准反演攻击。然而，面对显式建模扰动过程的"自适应攻击者"时，该防御是否仍安全尚不明确。论文核心动机在于系统性地评估噪声保护嵌入的隐私脆弱性，并提出首个在"无干净嵌入"约束下的端到端反演方案。
AI.method: DAEI 是一个四阶段流水线：(1) 基于 Stein 无偏风险估计 (SURE) 的残差去噪自编码器 (DAE) 无监督预训练，使用蒙特卡洛 Hutchinson 估计近似散度项；(2) 用 DAE 屏蔽后的去噪嵌入训练生成式反演器 (Inverter)；(3) 联合 SURE–CE 微调，采用 PCGrad 梯度手术解决两目标冲突；(4) 在校正器 (Corrector) 两侧均部署 DAE 屏蔽 (DAE Shield)，避免双噪声干扰。理论分析揭示了 Vec2Text 在噪声场景下失败的"双噪声陷阱"——目标嵌入与假设嵌入各自独立加噪后做差，使残差噪声方差加倍且主导修正信号。
AI.result: 在 GTR-base 和 GTE-base 两种不同架构的黑盒嵌入器上，DAEI 在域内 BLEU 较 Noisy Inverter 基线分别提升至 0.4875 与 0.3152，绝对增益约 0.19–0.30；F1/ROUGE-L 提升 32–60%；向量余弦相似度提升约 0.09–0.10。在 5 个域外数据集 (AG News、Anthropic、Python Code、Climate-FEVER、MedMCQA) 上均显著优于基线，并在 σ∈[0.005,0.018] 噪声范围内保持稳定。DAE 使嵌入 MSE 降低 23.8–29.2%，局部本征维数 (LID) 恢复到干净水平。DAEI 较 Clean-to-Clean 上界可恢复 71.7–89.2% 的文本质量。
AI.conclusion: 论文挑战了"高斯加噪足以保护嵌入隐私"的普遍假设，证实自适应去噪感知攻击可在仅有噪声观测条件下高质量还原原文。研究呼吁 (1) 隐私保护嵌入系统需面向自适应攻击者重新评估；(2) 未来需开发比简单高斯扰动更鲁棒的防御机制以应对 DAEI 类攻击。论文局限性在于攻击者需近似已知噪声尺度 σ（可通过少量校准查询估计）。

title: Aslema at NADI 2026: Augmentation through Fewshot for SLU
comment: LLMs, Native, Arabic LLMs, Augmentation, Multilingual, Multimodal, Language Diversity, Contextual Understanding, Minority Languages, Culturally Informed, Foundation Models, Large Language Models, Audio Models, Omni Models, Slot Filling
summary: We present Aslema, our system for NADI 2026 Shared Task 5, which consists of two subtasks: intent recognition and slot filling. We evaluate four omni LLMs in a zero-shot setting and compare them with fine-tuned models. Our results show that fine-tuning consistently outperforms zero-shot inference. We further explore synthetic data augmentation by using an LLM to generate culturally grounded Tunisian Derja utterances, followed by voice cloning to generate synthetic speech. Incorporating this synthetic data improves performance on both tasks. Our final submitted system, based on Qwen3-Omni-30B and trained with a mixture of original and synthetic data, achieves 86.8% intent accuracy and 34.7 WER on the devtest split. On the official test set it ranks 1st in slot filling (59.5 CoER) and 4th among 8 teams in intent recognition (66.1% accuracy). We release our experimental scripts and will soon share the synthetic dataset to support further research in this area.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Aslema 系统在 NADI 2026 共享任务 5（突尼斯阿拉伯语 Derja 方言的端到端口语理解 SLU）中的参赛方案，针对意图识别和槽位填充两个子任务，评估了四种 omni LLM 的零样本与微调表现，并通过 LLM+TTS 数据增强显著提升了低资源方言场景下的性能，最终在官方测试中取得槽位填充第 1 名、意图识别第 4 名（共 8 队）。
AI.motivation: 突尼斯方言 Derja 是低资源、严重与法语英语混合的方言，与现代标准阿拉伯语差异大，现有声学大模型对其支持有限。SLURP-TN 数据集仅有约 2.8 小时训练语音且类别极不均衡，意图标签在测试集中扩展至 60 个，远多于训练时的 23 个，给开放意图泛化和少样本建模带来挑战。论文旨在系统评估音视频多模态大模型在零样本与 LoRA 微调条件下的表现，并探索合成数据增强对低资源方言 SLU 的有效性。
AI.method: 方法包括三大模块：(1) 评估并微调四种 omni LLM（Qwen2.5-Omni-3B/7B、Qwen3-Omni-30B、Gemma-4-E4B-it）以及 Whisper-small 基线，使用 ms-swift+vLLM 在单卡 H200 上通过 LoRA（rank=16, α=32, lr=1e-4）进行两轮联合微调；(2) 构建 LLM+TTS 合成数据增强管线：使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro/3.6 Flash 基于 Self-Instruct 少样本生成突尼斯 Derja 含槽位标注的文本，经规则过滤+三模型多数投票保留 12,138 条，再通过 VoxCPM 零样本声音克隆合成语音（含 LoRA 微调版本），经声学过滤保留 22,940 条；(3) 真实+合成混合数据微调 Qwen3-Omni-30B，并通过将 general_quirky 决定性映射为 unknown 解决开放意图问题。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 零样本下四个 omni 模型意图准确率仅 29.2%–53.1%，CoER 高达 97.5–150.1，全部弱于全微调 Whisper-small（67.4%/81.4）；(2) LoRA 微调后性能大幅提升，Qwen3-Omni-30B 达 82.9% 意图准确率和 47.7 CoER，且不同规模模型的差距从 23.9 缩小到 2.5 分；(3) 真实+合成混合数据微调 Qwen3-Omni-30B 在开发测试集取得最佳 86.8% 意图准确率、34.7 WER、36.9 CoER，相对纯真实数据提升 3.9 点准确率和 10.8 点 CoER，而纯合成数据反而降至 75.6%/62.2；(4) 官方盲测试集上系统以 59.5 CoER 排名槽位填充第 1、66.1% 准确率排名意图识别第 4（8 队中），其中意图准确率经 general_quirky→unknown 映射提升 35.7 点。
